Our enterprise customers across multiple verticals are empowered to personalize experiences with consumers at an individual level across every channel, delivering better results for marketing programs. Zeta was founded in 2007 by David A. Steinberg and John Sculley and is headquartered in New York City with offices around the world. raw.title: Product Designer (m/f/d)- Physical Products & AI - home decor brand - 100% remote - part-/fulltime
raw.description:
For my client, an established direct-to-consumer home decor brand, I’m looking for a talented Product Designer to join the team on a long-term basis.

The company creates distinctive wooden home decor for customers primarily in the US, with a strong focus on wall art alongside selected freestanding pieces.

We’re looking for someone who combines a strong design eye with commercial thinking and hands-on AI skills — someone who can turn ideas and market insights into products customers genuinely want to buy.

Tasks

Your main responsibility will be to develop new, sellable physical products from idea to launch.

You’ll identify promising product opportunities through a mix of market and competitor research, emerging trends, existing bestsellers and your own creative ideas.

From there, you’ll take concepts through the full development process:

  • Create and visualize new product concepts using AI image-generation tools
  • Refine ideas into commercially viable product directions
  • Collaborate with CAD designers to translate concepts into manufacturable designs
  • Work with suppliers and factories throughout sampling and development
  • Coordinate with the content and advertising teams to prepare products for launch
  • Manage several product concepts and development projects in parallel

Requirements

  • Hands-on experience with AI image generation, using tools such as Nano Banana, Adobe Firefly, Flux or similar
  • Experience designing physical products — not solely graphic, digital or UX/UI design
  • A strong eye for aesthetics, form and commercial product design, demonstrated through a portfolio
  • Highly organized, reliable and comfortable managing multiple projects simultaneously
  • Fluent English

Strong Plus

  • Experience in home decor, furniture, interiors or lifestyle products
  • A background working with wood, handcrafted products or similar materials
  • A strong understanding of US home decor trends and customer preferences
  • Experience collaborating with factories, manufacturers or suppliers, including product sampling and iterations

Benefits

What You Can Expect

  • 🌍 100% remote – work from anywhere
  • ⏰ Flexible setup – part-time or full-time both possible
  • 🚀 High level of ownership over new products from the earliest idea through launch
  • 🎨 Creative freedom to explore trends, concepts and entirely new product directions
  • 🤖 AI-first product development environment, with modern tools integrated into the creative process
  • 📈 Steep learning curve across product development, eCommerce and performance-driven product launches
  • 🤝 International, entrepreneurial team with fast decision-making and close collaboration
  • 📦 Direct exposure to the full product lifecycle, from concept and sampling to content, advertising and launch
  • 🔄 Long-term collaboration with consistent opportunities to develop and launch new products
  • 🚀 Start as soon as possible

If you’re a product designer who enjoys combining creativity, AI, commercial thinking and hands-on physical product development, I’d be happy to hear from you.

Please apply with your CV, portfolio and a few examples of products or concepts you’ve personally developed.

title: Senior Product Manager - Salesforce & Internal Enablement (all genders)
description: Responsibilities We are looking for an experienced, passionate, and hands-on Senior Product Manager to join our product team and empower Aroundhome’s core business operations for our next phase of growth. Aroundhome is Germany's leading platform for home projects, connecting thousands of homeowners with the right local service partners. The Internal Enablement team owns the core CRM and operational infrastructure -primarily built on Salesforce- that powers our sales teams and customer care in the future. By transforming fragmented, legacy setups into a scalable, automated core, your work directly enables our business teams to drive growth and deliver a seamless experience to our partner network. At Aroundhome, Product Managers play a pivotal role in shaping our platform’s success. We work in a domain-based model, where each cross-functional product team has full ownership over a clearly defined part of the platform. This structure fosters close collaboration and ensures that expertise for continuous product discovery and iterative improvement sits directly within each domain. As a Senior Product Manager for Internal Enablement, you will translate our growth strategies into a clear future-state vision for our operational ecosystem. You will drive process automation, data consistency, and core tool integration, ensuring our platform can scale efficiently as we significantly expand our business. As a Senior Product Manager, you define and execute a strategic product roadmap that translates our growth goals into a modern, future-proof Salesforce ecosystem. You combine user research, process analysis, and quantitative data to identify root problems and systematically validate high-impact opportunities. You challenge legacy workflows to design reusable capabilities, clean data flows, and clear technical boundaries between Salesforce and connected systems. You make evidence-based decisions to prioritize your backlog, focusing relentlessly on business growth and operational scalability. You partner closely with Salesforce Architects, Salesforce Administrators, Data and Engineers to manage the product lifecycle and release testable, incremental value quickly. You align business stakeholders across Sales and Operations, actively guiding internal teams through training, change management and process adoption. You track clear success metrics to measure operational efficiency gains, while exploring AI applications to continuously optimize workflows and user outcomes. Skills Proven track record as a Senior Product Manager driving large-scale CRM transformations, with deep hands-on expertise in the Salesforce ecosystem (certifications are a strong plus). Expertise in continuous product discovery and translating high-level business goals into measurable, outcome-based metrics. Strong understanding of system architecture, data synchronization, and API-based integrations between Salesforce and complex adjacent tools. Exceptional communication and storytelling skills to align cross-functional teams and actively drive product adoption across all organizational levels. Hands-on experience integrating AI tools into daily workflows (e.g., for research, technical discovery, or prototyping) to boost productivity and innovation. Business fluency in both English and German is required to effectively collaborate with tech teams and drive change management with local operational staff. What we offer Hybrid Work // Stay flexible: We embrace a hybrid working model that balances the autonomy of remote work with purposeful in-person collaboration. Ideally, you are based in Berlin or live within an easy commuting distance. While we offer flexibility, monthly presence in our office for team days, workshops, and meetings is required. Additionally, we offer you the possibility to work up to 30 days per year from selected EU countries. Room to grow // Stay curious: In regular/annual feedback meetings, you design your own personal development path together with your team lead. In addition, we offer an annual training budget, free access to LinkedIn Learning, as well as great workshops to seek new input and specific training for your personal development. Mental & physical health // Stay healthy & active: We care about your well-being and support your health with a discounted membership at Urban Sports Club. In addition, our cooperation partner "Fürstenberg Institute" is available to you and your family members with advice and support when it comes to mental health & coaching. Taking responsibility // We #care: We care for our planet and the people who are living on it. To make our world a little bit better, our ESG Team (Environmental, Social & Governance) promotes our awareness of environmentally friendly behavior. In addition, we work with JobRad, offer a discounted BVG ticket, and actively support social projects in Berlin at our annual Social Day to give something back. Teamspirit // Stay connected: What drives us is our sense of community. That's why we celebrate our Company Day once a month in our office at Potsdamer Platz, where everyone gets together in person. In addition to a comprehensive update of our C-Board, the main focus is on togetherness and the exchange of ideas over lunch and dinner together. Transparency // We want to be transparent, also when it comes to salary: If you have any questions about a possible salary range for this position, feel free to send us an email at ----- We will get back to you as soon as possible. Wir suchen dich als Elternzeitvertretung in Vollzeit für einen Zeitraum von 18 - 24 Monaten, je nach Einstiegszeit. Teilzeit ist ab einem Stundenumfang von 35 h ebenfalls möglich.

#Einkauf:
Du verantwortest die Abwicklung und Koordination von Einkaufs- und Beschaffungsaktivitäten für dir zugeordnete Hersteller.

Zahlen sind dein Ding! Du erstellst Kalkulationen oder Reports und hast die Konkurrenz sowie Preisentwicklungen stets im Auge.

Du bist Ansprechpartner für Kollegen aus anderen Fachabteilungen und arbeitest eng mit dem Produktmarketing bei der Steuerung von Produktkampagnen zusammen.

Dich erwarten abwechslungsreiche Tätigkeiten, nutze die Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten in einem Wachstumsunternehmen und profitiere von kurzen Entscheidungswegen. 
#Team: 
Wir arbeiten auf allen Hierarchieebenen eng zusammen und sind vom Vorstand bis Azubi per ‚Du‘. Du kannst dich jederzeit auf dein Team verlassen. Dieses lernst du im digitalen Probearbeiten kennen.

Vieles ist learning-on-the-job, aber wir schicken dich auch auf firmeneigene Fortbildungsprogramme.

Du übernimmst schnell Verantwortung für Teilprojekte und Hersteller. Wir geben dir die Tools an die Hand, sodass du nach der Einarbeitung eigenständig Produkte betreuen kannst.

Unser Arbeitskonzept sieht eine Mischung aus mobilem Arbeiten und Arbeiten aus dem Büro heraus vor. Je nach Einsatzbereich kann die Anzahl der Büroarbeitstage variieren. 


Was solltest du mitbringen?

#Background:
Du hast dein Studium abgeschlossen oder eine kaufmännische Ausbildung absolviert und hast schon erste praktische Erfahrungen im eCommerce-Umfeld, Produktmanagement oder Marketing sammeln können?

Technik lässt dein Herz höherschlagen - ein Expertenwissen rund um Elektronikprodukte musst du jedoch nicht mitbringen. Dank deiner sehr guten Auffassungsgabe findest du dich nämlich schnell in neue Produktbereiche ein und baust Fachwissen dazu auf.

Du bist aufgeschlossen und überzeugst deine Gesprächspartner mit deinem sicheren Auftreten und deinen sehr guten kommunikativen Fähigkeiten. Dazu hast du noch ein Gespür für gute Deals und erreichst damit beste Einkaufspreise.

Dich zeichnen eine strukturierte Arbeitsweise, Flexibilität und ein unternehmerisches Denken aus. Du arbeitest selbstständig und eigeninitiativ, bist aber auch ein echter Teamplayer.

Excel oder sogar Pivot sind für dich Tools, mit denen du schon gearbeitet hast. Dank deiner Englischkenntnisse könntest du auch in Terminen mit internationalen Lieferanten und Herstellern überzeugen.

Du findest dich nicht zu 100% in dieser Beschreibung wieder? Kein Problem - überzeuge uns, warum du dennoch der/die Richtige bist ;)

title: Working Student International Energy Advisory (m/w/d)
description: Westbridge-Gruppe | Was uns antreibt Gebäude müssen heute mehr leisten als je zuvor: effizienter werden, Ressourcen schonen und gleichzeitig wirtschaftlich betrieben werden. Dafür braucht es Transparenz, messbare Daten und intelligente Lösungen. Als einer der führenden Energie- und Nachhaltigkeitsberater für die Immobilienwirtschaft in Europa treiben wir diesen Wandel aktiv mit. Wir unterstützen unsere Kundinnen und Kunden dabei, Gebäude und Portfolios fit für die Zukunft zu machen – von der ersten strategischen Idee über die technische Planung bis hin zur erfolgreichen Umsetzung. Um diesen Weg weiterzugehen und gemeinsam mit unseren Kundinnen und Kunden die Energieversorgung von morgen zu gestalten, suchen wir dich als Working Student im Projektmanagement (m/w/d) für unser Team Energy International in Frankfurt am Main . Deine Aufgaben In deiner Rolle übernimmst du Verantwortung und arbeitest gemeinsam mit deinem Team an Lösungen für anspruchsvolle Fragestellungen. Zu deinen Aufgaben gehören unter anderem: Du unterstützt das Projektmanagement International bei der Entwicklung und Umsetzung innovativer Konzepte zur Kostenoptimierung sowie Effizienzsteigerung im Energieverbrauch. Im Rahmen deiner Tätigkeit wirkst Du bei der Analyse, Aufbereitung und Auswertung projektrelevanter Daten mit und leistest damit einen wichtigen Beitrag zur Entscheidungsfindung. Du unterstützt das Team im operativen Projektmanagement-Tagesgeschäft und übernimmst dabei organisatorische und koordinative Aufgaben. Zudem begleitest du Ausschreibungsprozesse sowie Bietergespräche und unterstützt bei der Kommunikation mit externen Partnern, insbesondere internationale Energieversorgern. Die Vorbereitung und Strukturierung von Vertragsunterlagen für Verhandlungen gehört ebenfalls zu deinem Aufgabenbereich. Darüber hinaus erstellst du Präsentationen zur Ableitung von Handlungsempfehlungen und wirkst bei der Aufbereitung von Ergebnissen für interne und externe Stakeholder mit. Das bringst du mit Fachliche Kompetenz, Kommunikationsstärke und die Bereitschaft, dich in neue Themen einzuarbeiten, sind für uns genauso wichtig wie deine Freude an Zusammenarbeit und daran, gemeinsam gute Lösungen zu entwickeln. Du befindest dich aktuell in einem Studium an einer Fach- oder Hochschule – vorzugsweise in den Bereichen Wirtschaftswissenschaften, Energiewirtschaft oder BWL. Idealerweise hast du bereits erste Erfahrungen im Bereich Projektmanagement oder in der Energie- bzw. Immobilienwirtschaft gesammelt. Du zeichnest dich durch lösungsorientiertes, analytisches und strukturiertes Denken und Handeln aus. Teamfähigkeit und Einsatzbereitschaft gehören ebenso zu deinen Stärken wie ein professionelles und sicheres Auftreten. Du verfügst über gute Grundkenntnisse in MS-Office-Anwendungen, insbesondere in Excel. So arbeiten wir Du arbeitest eng mit Kolleginnen und Kollegen aus unterschiedlichen Fachrichtungen zusammen und erhältst Einblicke in spannende Projekte und Themen rund um die Energie- und Nachhaltigkeitsberatung. Dabei kannst du dein Wissen aus dem Studium einbringen, praktische Erfahrungen sammeln und dich fachlich weiterentwickeln. Damit dies gelingt, bieten wir dir die entsprechenden Rahmenbedingungen: Wir bieten dir einen Arbeitsplatz, an dem du dich gut einfinden und konzentriert arbeiten kannst – mit moderner Ausstattung, guter Anbindung an den öffentlichen Nahverkehr sowie Getränken, Snacks und frischem Obst. Bei Werkstudententätigkeiten richten wir uns nach deinem Studium: Während des Semesters kannst du uns bis zu 20 Stunden pro Woche unterstützen, in der vorlesungsfreien Zeit nach Absprache auch in Vollzeit. Praktika absolvierst du bei uns in Vollzeit. Dein nächster Schritt Wir freuen uns darauf, dich kennenzulernen und mit dir darüber zu sprechen, wie dein nächster beruflicher Schritt aussehen soll – und ob wir der richtige Partner dafür sind. Für unser Team in Frankfurt am Main suchen wir daher einen Working Student Finance (m/w/d) , der Finance nicht nur aus dem Studium kennt, sondern die unterschiedlichen Bereiche in der Praxis kennenlernen und aktiv an operativen Themen, Transformationsprojekten und M&A-bezogenen Fragestellungen mitarbeiten möchte. Deine Aufgaben Als Teil unseres Finance-Teams lernst du die unterschiedlichen Facetten von Finance aus nächster Nähe kennen und arbeitest an operativen, analytischen und projektbezogenen Fragestellungen mit. Dabei bist du eng mit unseren Funktionen Accounting & Tax, FP&A und Finance Transformation sowie den jeweiligen Directors im Austausch. Dabei erhältst du einen direkten Einblick in unsere Planungs-, Forecasting - und Reporting-Prozesse und lernst, finanzielle Entwicklungen einzuordnen und ihre wesentlichen Treiber zu verstehen. Finance Transformation: Du unterstützt bei der Weiterentwicklung unserer Finance-Prozesse und wirkst bei der Konzeption und Umsetzung konkreter Verbesserungsmaßnahmen mit. Dabei begleitest du unter anderem die Automatisierung wiederkehrender Abläufe sowie die Einführung und Weiterentwicklung neuer Systeme und Technologien im Finance-Bereich. M&A & PMI: Du unterstützt bei M&A-bezogenen Finance-Fragestellungen und erhältst Einblicke in Transaktionen und Due-Diligence-Prozesse. Ein besonderer Schwerpunkt liegt auf der Post-Merger-Integration: Hier wirkst du dabei mit, neu erworbene Gesellschaften in unsere Finance-Strukturen zu integrieren und Prozesse, Daten und Systeme zusammenzuführen. Accounting: Du unterstützt unser Accounting-Team im operativen Tagesgeschäft und lernst dabei die zentralen Prozesse der Finanzbuchhaltung aus erster Hand kennen. Darüber hinaus wirkst du bei Monats-, Jahres- und Konzernabschlüssen mit und entwickelst so ein fundiertes Verständnis dafür, wie Accounting und Reporting in der Praxis zusammenspielen. Du bist in einem Masterstudiengang oder mindestens im vierten Fachsemster eines Bachelorstudiengangs der Betriebswirtschaftslehre, Wirtschaftswissenschaften oder einem vergleichbaren Studiengang eingeschrieben und hast deinen Studienschwerpunkt im Bereich Finance, Accounting oder Controlling gesetzt. Du hast bereits Erfahrung im Umgang mit KI-basierten Tools und setzt diese gezielt ein, um Aufgaben effizienter zu bearbeiten, Informationen zu strukturieren und die Qualität deiner Arbeitsergebnisse zu verbessern. Dabei bist du eng mit unseren Funktionen Accounting & Tax, FP&A und Finance Transformation sowie den jeweiligen Directors im Austausch. Neben dem laufenden Finance-Tagesgeschäft wirkst du auch an Transformationsprojekten, M&A-bezogenen Themen und der Weiterentwicklung unserer Finance-Strukturen und -Prozesse mit. 

  • FP&A & Reporting: Du unterstützt bei der Analyse von Umsatz-, Kosten- und Ergebnisentwicklungen sowie bei der Aufbereitung relevanter Kennzahlen und Management-Auswertungen. Dabei erhältst du einen direkten Einblick in unsere Planungs-, Forecasting- und Reporting-Prozesse und lernst, finanzielle Entwicklungen einzuordnen und ihre wesentlichen Treiber zu verstehen.
  • Finance Transformation: Du unterstützt bei der Weiterentwicklung unserer Finance-Prozesse und wirkst bei der Konzeption und Umsetzung konkreter Verbesserungsmaßnahmen mit. Dabei begleitest du unter anderem die Automatisierung wiederkehrender Abläufe sowie die Einführung und Weiterentwicklung neuer Systeme und Technologien im Finance-Bereich.
  • M&A & PMI: Du unterstützt bei M&A-bezogenen Finance-Fragestellungen und erhältst Einblicke in Transaktionen und Due-Diligence-Prozesse. Ein besonderer Schwerpunkt liegt auf der Post-Merger-Integration: Hier wirkst du dabei mit, neu erworbene Gesellschaften in unsere Finance-Strukturen zu integrieren und Prozesse, Daten und Systeme zusammenzuführen.
  • Accounting: Du unterstützt unser Accounting-Team im operativen Tagesgeschäft und lernst dabei die zentralen Prozesse der Finanzbuchhaltung aus erster Hand kennen. Darüber hinaus wirkst du bei Monats-, Jahres- und Konzernabschlüssen mit und entwickelst so ein fundiertes Verständnis dafür, wie Accounting und Reporting in der Praxis zusammenspielen.
  • Strategische Finance-Projekte: Du arbeitest an bereichsübergreifenden Finance-Projekten und aktuellen Fragestellungen mit und übernimmst dabei eigene Teilaufgaben. So erhältst du die Möglichkeit, Themen von der Analyse und Konzeption bis zur konkreten Umsetzung zu begleiten und zunehmend Verantwortung zu übernehmen.


Das bringst du mit

Du hast ein gutes Verständnis für Zahlen und wirtschaftliche Zusammenhänge, denkst analytisch und arbeitest dich schnell in neue Themen ein. Gleichzeitig packst du gerne selbst mit an, kommunizierst offen und klar und fühlst dich in einem dynamischen Umfeld wohl, in dem sich Themen und Prioritäten auch kurzfristig verändern können. Dabei bringst du die nötige Flexibilität und Eigeninitiative mit, um Verantwortung zu übernehmen und Themen aktiv voranzubringen. 

  • Du bist in einem Masterstudiengang oder mindestens im vierten Fachsemster eines Bachelorstudiengangs der Betriebswirtschaftslehre, Wirtschaftswissenschaften oder einem vergleichbaren Studiengang eingeschrieben und hast deinen Studienschwerpunkt im Bereich Finance, Accounting oder Controlling gesetzt.
  • Idealerweise hast du bereits erste praktische Erfahrungen im Finance-Umfeld gesammelt, beispielsweise im Accounting, Controlling, FP&A, in der Wirtschaftsprüfung oder Beratung.
  • Auch bei mehreren parallel laufenden Themen behältst du den Überblick und arbeitest strukturiert, sorgfältig und zuverlässig.
  • Du verfügst über sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift.
  • Du bist digital affin, verfügst über sehr gute MS-Office-Kenntnisse – insbesondere in Excel und PowerPoint – und arbeitest dich schnell und gerne in neue Tools und Finance-Systeme ein. Erste Erfahrungen mit Anwendungen wie DATEV, LucaNet oder Power BI sind ein Plus, aber kein Muss.
  • Du hast bereits Erfahrung im Umgang mit KI-basierten Tools und setzt diese gezielt ein, um Aufgaben effizienter zu bearbeiten, Informationen zu strukturieren und die Qualität deiner Arbeitsergebnisse zu verbessern.

title: Platform Engineer (m/f/d)
description: What we are building ecoplanet builds the operating system for the energy transition. Our software helps European businesses cut energy costs, run more efficiently, and take the pain out of managing energy day to day. We are around 40 people and backed by EQT Ventures, HV Capital and others. Why This Role Matters You build and run the platform the whole product sits on: the event streams, the backend services and the cloud infrastructure everything else is built on. Meter readings arrive from industrial sites across Europe, through messages or us accessing APIs. Your job is to make sure that traffic lands reliably, moves through the system in a shape other teams can build on, and keeps doing so as the number of sites grows. You join a team of 12 engineers in two squads. Small team, real ownership, and what you build reaches customers in weeks rather than quarters. What you will work on Event streaming. Kafka is the spine of the system. You own topic and schema design, partitioning, retention and delivery semantics and the everyday reality behind them: consumers falling behind, replays, backfills, late and duplicated readings. Backend services in TypeScript. The ingestion services, integrations and APIs around that stream. raw.title: Platform Engineer (m/f/d)
raw.description:
What we are building

ecoplanet builds the operating system for the energy transition. Our software helps European businesses cut energy costs, run more efficiently, and take the pain out of managing energy day to day. We are around 40 people and backed by EQT Ventures, HV Capital and others.


Why This Role Matters

You build and run the platform the whole product sits on: the event streams, the backend services and the cloud infrastructure everything else is built on. Meter readings arrive from industrial sites across Europe, through messages or us accessing APIs. Your job is to make sure that traffic lands reliably, moves through the system in a shape other teams can build on, and keeps doing so as the number of sites grows.
You join a team of 12 engineers in two squads. Small team, real ownership, and what you build reaches customers in weeks rather than quarters.

What you will work on

  • Event streaming. Kafka is the spine of the system. You own topic and schema design, partitioning, retention and delivery semantics  and the everyday reality behind them: consumers falling behind, replays, backfills, late and duplicated readings.
  • Backend services in TypeScript. The ingestion services, integrations and APIs around that stream. Every site is a little different, so a good part of the job is turning that variety into one consistent interface the product squads can rely on.
  • Cloud infrastructure on GCP. Compute, networking, IAM, infrastructure as code, CI/CD and observability. The goal is a paved road: other engineers ship and debug their own services without going through you.
  • Technical direction. You are senior enough to set it. Where we invest in the platform, what we standardise, what we deliberately leave rough for now  and bringing the rest of the team along with it.


What Sets You Up for Success

Must have:

  • At least 6–8 years building and running backend systems in production, including real time in a platform or infrastructure role that other engineers depended on
  • Strong backend engineering in TypeScript. You have designed, shipped and operated services and APIs in it — not just touched it around the edges of a frontend
  • Hands-on with Kafka in production. Topic design, consumer groups, ordering and delivery guarantees, and what you actually do at 3am when a consumer group is hours behind. A comparable streaming platform is fine if you know it at that depth
  • Solid on GCP or an equivalent cloud: containers, networking and IAM basics, infrastructure as code, CI/CD, monitoring and alerting. You have owned infrastructure, not just deployed onto it
  • Comfortable with high-volume time-series data: ingestion, data quality, backfills, and the everyday reality of late, missing and duplicated readings
  • You have seen a few things. Enough production years behind you to know which trade-offs come back to bite, when the boring option is the right one, and how to make a call with incomplete information instead of waiting for certainty
  • Kubernetes knowledge at the level of running it, not only deploying to it.
  • Clear written and spoken English. German is a plus
Nice to have:
  • Energy, industrial, IoT or another domain where the data comes off real hardware
  • Metering or device protocols, telemetry at scale, or streaming pipelines
  • Knowledge of a second programming language, like Python, Go or Kotlin
  • You run what you build: monitoring, alerting, and the occasional early morning debugging a pipeline


What You Get

  • Top-of-market team, flat hierarchy — work alongside people who push you to get better
  • Competitive salary
  • Full ownership from day one — you actively shape our company
  • Central office, easy commute — free lunch every Tuesday and Thursday
  • Wellpass membership
  • Regular 1:1s and retros focused on your growth
  • Real impact — your work supports Europe's transition to a smarter energy system

title: Senior ML Engineer | Kimchi (LLM Inference Optimization)
description: <h4>Why Cast AI?</h4> <p>Cast AI is an automation platform that operates cloud-native and AI infrastructure at scale. By embedding autonomous decision-making directly into Kubernetes and cloud environments, Cast AI continuously optimizes performance, reliability, and efficiency in production.<br>The old way doesn't work. As Kubernetes and AI environments grow, manual decisions don’t. Cast AI replaces tickets, alerts, and manual tuning with continuous automation that adapts infrastructure as conditions change. Efficiency and cost savings follow naturally from that automation.<br>Over 2,100 companies already rely on Cast AI, including Akamai, BMW, Cisco, FICO, HuggingFace, NielsenIQ, Swisscom, and TGS.<br><br><strong>Global team, diverse perspectives</strong></p> <p>We're headquartered in Miami, but our impact is international. We take a global and intentional approach to diversity. Today, Cast AI operates across 34 countries spanning Europe, North America, Latin America, and APAC, bringing a wide range of perspectives into how we build and lead.<br><br><strong>Unicorn momentum</strong></p> <p>In January 2026, we achieved unicorn status with a strategic investment from Pacific Alliance Ventures, the corporate venture arm of Shinsegae Group (a $50+ billion Korean conglomerate). Our valuation now exceeds $1 billion, and we're just getting started.</p> <p><strong>Join us as we build the future of autonomous infrastructure.</strong></p> <h4>About the role</h4> <p>Throughput. Latency. KV cache utilization.</p> <p>Move those three numbers in the right direction, and two things happen: customers get faster, cheaper inference, and our margins improve. That's the entire thesis of this role. Every kernel you tune, every quantization scheme you ship, every scheduler tweak you land shows up directly in a customer's p99 and on our P&amp;L.<br>This is a high-impact seat. It is also a high-autonomy seat as you'll be given the room to lead the technical direction of inference optimization at Kimchi, not execute someone else's roadmap.</p> <p><strong>The problem: </strong>running LLMs in production is a moving target. The "right" model and serving configuration for a workload depend on traffic shape, sequence-length distribution, batch dynamics, GPU SKU, memory bandwidth,&nbsp;quantization tolerance, and a dozen other variables that shift week to week. Most teams pick a model once, over-provision GPUs, and absorb the cost.&nbsp;Kimchi is the system that makes that decision automatically - continuously matching workloads to the most cost-efficient, best-performing LLM and serving configuration on a customer's infrastructure. We're&nbsp;building the optimization layer between the model and the hardware, and we need engineers who understand both sides deeply.</p> <p><strong>Stack</strong></p> <p>Python; vLLM; SGLang; TensorRT-LLM; PyTorch; CUDA-adjacent tooling; Kubernetes; gRP; ClickHouse; PostgreSQL; GCP Pub/Sub; AWS / GCP / Azure; GitLab CI; ArgoCD; Prometheus; Grafana; Loki; Tempo.</p> <h4>Requirements:</h4> <ul> <li>5+ years building real ML systems, with a portfolio that shows depth in inference or training infrastructure (not just model training notebooks).</li> <li>Strong Python - production services, not scripts.</li> <li>Hands-on experience with at least one of vLLM, SGLang, or TensorRT-LLM, and a working mental model of why an inference engine performs the way it does on a given GPU.</li> <li>Fluency with quantization tradeoffs - you've measured quality regressions, not just compression ratios.</li> <li>Comfort with distributed systems: collective communication, sharding strategies, and the practical failure modes of multi-GPU and multi-node setups.</li> <li>A bias toward measurement. You instrument before you optimize, and you can tell the difference between a real win and a benchmark artifact.</li> <li>Self-direction. This role comes with a wide mandate; you should be excited by that, not unsettled by it.</li> </ul> <h4>Responsibilities:</h4> <ul> <li>Push throughput. Communication: Fluent English and the ability to explain complex technical trade-offs to non-technical stakeholders. What we care about Teamwork : collaborating and supporting each other within engineering and across functions Inclusion : creating an environment where everybody can bring their whole self and do their best work Ownership : empowering you to do the work that is most impactful Sustainability: balancing work with family and personal hobbies so we can be at our best Growth: supporting each other's learning and development Why topi? Impact from Day One - Your ideas are valued, and you actively shape our direction. No long feedback loops or complex hierarchies - you'll have a direct impact on what you do. Trust - We believe in our mission and in our team, offering trust-based working hours, permanent contracts, flexibility for home-country working. The Role: What to expect

Idealworks builds industrial automation as a coordinated system — mobile robots, orchestration software, simulation, and increasingly humanoids and physical AI, working together in real production environments rather than as isolated pilots. Since our founding within BMW Group and our integration into Agile Robots SE, we've grown from a Munich-based robotics team into a global player.

As physical AI and humanoid robotics move from research into industrial deployment, our project landscape is expanding: today's programs span classic mobile robot fleets, next-generation humanoid platforms, and the simulation environments used to develop and validate both. We're looking for a Senior Engineering Project Manager to lead this kind of work end to end - technically credible enough to sit with R&D and hardware/software engineering, and organized enough to keep shareholders, partners, and customers aligned as programs move from concept to production.


Role Responsibilities: What you will do

Project & Program Delivery

  • Manage complex engineering projects across the full lifecycle — from scoping and planning through execution, integration, testing, and handover — spanning both software and hardware workstreams.
  • Define and manage project plans, milestones, budgets, and resourcing; monitor schedule, cost, quality, and contractual compliance throughout.
  • Identify technical, schedule, and commercial risks early, and drive mitigation and contingency planning across multi-disciplinary teams.
  • Plan and coordinate integration and validation phases (e.g., factory and site acceptance testing) across hardware, software, and systems components.

Cross-Functional & Technical Coordination
  • Act as the connective layer between product management, partner management, solution engineering, software development, hardware development, R&D, innovation management, and operations — ensuring each function's inputs and dependencies are captured and sequenced correctly.
  • Work closely with engineering leads on cutting-edge developments in mobile robots, humanoid platforms, simulation tooling, and physical AI to translate technical realities into realistic, defensible project plans.
  • Support innovation and R&D initiatives as they mature into deployable projects, helping bridge the gap between exploratory work and production-grade delivery.

Stakeholder & Partner Management
  • Serve as a primary point of contact for a diverse stakeholder landscape, including shareholders, technology and integration partners, and customers, tailoring communication to each audience.
  • Prepare and lead steering committee meetings, status reviews, and escalation discussions; ensure decisions are documented and followed through.
  • Manage claims, change requests, and contract or scope amendments in coordination with commercial and legal stakeholders.
  • Build long-term, trust-based relationships with partners and customers that extend beyond a single project milestone.

Operational Excellence
  • Track and report on project and portfolio KPIs (schedule adherence, cost/margin, quality, and stakeholder satisfaction) to leadership and shareholders.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement of project management methodology, tooling, and best practices across the organization.
  • Support resource planning and prioritization across a portfolio of concurrent engineering projects.


Role Requirements: What you need to succeed

  • At least 5 years of experience in a similar role, or in a technical role such as engineering, software development, product management, program management, project management, or partner management, within the robotics industry or a domain of comparable technical complexity (e.g., autonomous systems, industrial automation, advanced hardware/software integration).
  • Demonstrated ability to manage complex, cross-functional engineering projects that combine hardware and software development.
  • Strong technical fluency to engage credibly with R&D, software, and hardware engineers on cutting-edge topics in mobile robotics, humanoids, simulation, or physical AI, without needing to be the domain expert yourself.
  • A track record of managing external stakeholders e.g. customers, partners, or investors including steering committees, escalations, and commercial discussions.
  • Solid grounding in project management fundamentals: planning, budgeting, risk management, and reporting.
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to translate between technical and business/executive audiences.
  • A degree in engineering, computer science, software development, mechatronics, robotics, or a related technical field is a plus.
  • Fluency in English required; German is a plus.
  • Willingness to travel internationally as project needs require.


Why idealworks

  • At idealworks, you will find an international working environment and become part of an experienced, open team where mutual trust counts. You will feel at home from the very first second!
  • Experience a first-hand start-up feeling and flat hierarchies with varied and responsible tasks that you work on independently.
  • Look forward to hybrid working model with 30 vacation days per year and various opportunities to balance your free time, family and job.
  • For your commitment to helping us achieve our mission, you will not only be rewarded with appreciation, but also with above-average pay including a bonus scheme and an annual personal development budget.
  • We offer exciting corporate benefits, an attractive company pension scheme and regular team events.
  • Our modern office is easily accessible by public transport, bike and car and offers numerous catering options for relaxed lunch breaks with your team.
  • Driven by our unique corporate culture, the five values "passion for results", "wellbeing", "personal growth", "trust" and "being and acting as one team" determine our daily actions and cooperation.

title: UGC Creator / Social Media Creator (m/w/d)
description: paselo ist ein junges, schnell wachsendes Unternehmen für hochwertige Ergänzungsfuttermittel für Hunde. Unsere Mission: Die Gesundheit und Lebensfreude von Hunden nachhaltig fördern – mit natürlichen, laborgeprüften Produkten, die wissenschaftlich fundiert sind und von Tierhaltern geschätzt werden. Worum es geht Unsere Produkte sind gefragt. Damit das so weiter geht, stellst du dich für unsere Werbeanzeigen und oragnischen Inhalte (Facebook, Instagram, TikTok) vor die Kamera. In der Konzeptionierung und im Videoschnitt erhältst du Unterstützung. Aufgaben Du produzierst Content, der nicht nach Werbung aussieht. Authentische Videos, starke Einstiege, verständliche Produktstories und Inhalte, die Menschen wirklich bis zum Ende anschauen. Du testest ständig neue Ansätze. Hooks, Formate, Skripte, Perspektiven, Storylines und Calls-to-Action – du produzierst nicht einfach mehr Content, sondern findest heraus, welcher Content funktioniert. Du verstehst unsere Zielgruppe. Du beschäftigst dich damit, was sie bewegt, welche Probleme sie hat, welche Sprache sie spricht und welche Situationen sie aus ihrem Alltag kennt. Daraus entstehen deine Ideen. Du bringst Produkte glaubwürdig in Geschichten unter. Kein Ablesen von Werbetexten und kein Hochglanz-Werbespot. Du zeigst Produkte so, wie echte Menschen sie entdecken, benutzen und weiterempfehlen würden. Qualifikation Du passt besonders gut zu uns, wenn du unsere Zielgruppe authentisch vor der Kamera repräsentieren kannst. Ein großer Teil unseres Contents richtet sich an Frauen ab ca. 45 Jahren. Deshalb suchen wir jemanden mit einem glaubwürdigen Gespür für diese Lebenswelt, ihre Themen, ihre Sprache und ihren Alltag. Da Hunde in unserem Content regelmäßig eine Rolle spielen, ist es ein großes Plus, wenn du einen eigenen Hund hast, mit dem du unkompliziert Content produzieren kannst. Entscheidend für uns sind jedoch nicht Alter oder Geschlecht, sondern ob du authentischen, glaubwürdigen und performanten Content für unsere Zielgruppe produzieren kannst. Benefits Leistungsgerechte Bezahlung. Fixum plus Provision. Wer abliefert, verdient deutlich über Werkstudenten-Niveau. Echte Eigenverantwortung. Der Aufbau eines Vertriebskanals von null – nicht die Assistenz beim Aufbau. Direkter Zugang zum Founder. Kurze Wege, schnelle Entscheidungen, kein Abstimmungs-Pingpong. Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung. Gib im Anschreiben gerne an, welche Art der Zusammenarbeit für dich interessant ist: Von freiberuflich über Minijob/Midijob bis Teilzeit sind wir für vieles offen. title: Director Content & Communication (m/w/d)
description: Gestalte mit uns die Agentur von morgen. Warum wir uns neu erfinden Märkte verändern sich immer schneller. Geopolitische Einflüsse, neue wirtschaftliche Rahmenbedingungen und die Möglichkeiten der KI verändern, was Unternehmen von einer Agentur brauchen. Wir sehen darin eine Chance: Wir definieren einen neuen Typ von Agentur und stellen uns neu auf. Unser Ziel ist der perfekte Fit für Unternehmen, die ihre eigene Rolle und die ihrer Agentur neu verstehen. Deshalb steht kreatives digitales Content-Marketing im Mittelpunkt unserer Arbeit. Unsere Kunden profitieren von Seniorität und Erfahrung in Marketing, Strategie und Konzeption. Ebenso profitieren sie von unserem Verständnis dafür, wie digitale und soziale Medien funktionieren. Seit 1989 begleiten wir vorwiegend mittelständische Unternehmen und Institutionen, und auf dieser Erfahrung bauen wir auf. Deine Rolle Für die Weiterentwicklung und Transformation der Agentur suchen wir einen Kommunikationsprofi (m/w/d), der diesen Prozess begleitet und mitgestaltet. Du arbeitest eng mit den Gesellschaftern/Geschäftsführern zusammen und trägst echte Verantwortung: für Kunden, für das Team und für die Richtung, in die sich die Agentur entwickelt. Aufgaben Was du bewegst Du gestaltest die Transformation zu einer content-zentrierten Kommunikationsagentur aktiv mit. Du sorgst dafür, dass sich bestehende Kunden und Partner mitgenommen fühlen und dass diese weiterhin auf hohem Niveau betreut werden. Du treibst die Fokussierung auf wenige Branchen voran: Health, Care, Lifestyle-Medizin, Retail und Hotellerie. Du entwickelst Content- und Kommunikationsstrategien und setzt sie mit dem Team und Partnern um, organisch und paid, auf allen relevanten Kanälen. Du führst ein junges Team, entwickelst es weiter und baust es bei Bedarf mit neuen Talenten aus. Whether it’s helping students secure funding or enabling brands to run impactful campaigns, we’re reshaping how education is funded — and discovered. You’ll play a pivotal role in ensuring rapid, regression-free delivery across iOS, Android, and Shorebird OTA updates for millions of students. In this role, you will champion the "new generation" of quality engineering. What You’ll Do End-to-End Web Automation: Build, maintain, and execute parallelized E2E smoke and regression test pipelines using Patrol integrated directly into Codemagic and GitLab CI pipeline. API & Contract QA: Establish automated contract and API integration testing to validate GraphQL schema updates against mobile query requirements, guaranteeing zero breaking changes. AI Integration: Deeply integrate AI tools (Cursor, Copilot, ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini) into daily workflows to generate Patrol scripts directly from Figma specs, synthesize complex mock payloads, and automate log triage to double QA efficiency. Shift-Left Quality Champion: Review feature specs in Figma and GraphQL schema definitions early to catch edge cases, logic gaps, and design flaws before sprint commitments and development begin. Participate actively in PR reviews. System Observability & Triage: Monitor build health, Firebase Remote Config/Analytics, Sentry error logs, and GCP Cloud Run logs to triage issues across Flutter BLoC/UI state, GraphQL resolvers, and backend services, logging rich GitLab issues with dev-ready context. Exploratory & Release Testing: Conduct testing across iOS Simulators, Android Emulators, physical devices, TestFlight, Google Play Console internal tracks, and Shorebird OTA hot-patches. Component Testing: Utilize Flutter Storybook to conduct visual regression and component-level testing early in the release lifecycle. API & Schema Verification: Proficiency in testing GraphQL APIs (Bruno, Postman, Playwright, or HTTP clients), including schema validation, headers, and JWT auth flows. Mobile Ecosystem & Design: Comfort inspecting Figma files for UI specs/design tokens, using Xcode/Android Studio tools, managing Firebase Remote Config & feature flags, and navigating mobile app deployment lifecycles (Apple App Store / TestFlight, Google Play Console internal testing). CI/CD & Mobile DevOps: Experience with mobile CI/CD tools (Codemagic, GitLab CI) and Git/GitLab workflows. Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent practical experience in software development / test automation. Communication: Clear, concise async communication skills in written and spoken English for bug reporting, documentation, and remote collaboration. Nice to Have AI-Native Focus: Advanced proficiency loading architecture specs, GraphQL schemas, and UI design tokens into AI models to auto-generate test cases, Patrol page objects, and mock payloads. Dart & Component Testing: Direct Dart / Flutter coding ability to write unit and widget tests in-repo, as well as Flutter Storybook experience. OTA & Scripting: Experience with Shorebird (OTA hot patching for Flutter) or basic TypeScript / Bun experience for writing Bruno test collections or schema scripts. Cloud Infrastructure & Feature Flags: Exposure to GCP (Cloud Run, Cloud Logging) and Unleash feature flag management. Certifications: Certifications in Quality Engineering, Mobile Testing, or AI-Assisted Software Engineering. Consumer Mobile SaaS: Previous experience testing consumer mobile apps, EdTech platforms, subscription/billing systems (Stripe, in-app purchases), or user onboarding funnels. Why Join ScholarshipOwl? Owl Shine Program: Monthly employee recognition and awards celebrating extraordinary contributions. raw.description:
About ScholarshipOwl

ScholarshipOwl is the largest scholarship marketplace in the US, using AI to connect 14 million students who are looking for scholarships with companies that are looking for students. Our mission is to make education financing more accessible and engaging, while giving brands a way to connect with the next generation.

We’re powered by AI technology that simplifies scholarship discovery, streamlines the application process, and delivers measurable results for both students and partners. Whether it’s helping students secure funding or enabling brands to run impactful campaigns, we’re reshaping how education is funded — and discovered.

The Role

We’re looking for a highly skilled and innovative Mobile QA Engineer to lead end-to-end quality assurance, test automation, and release stability for our ScholarshipOwl Flutter mobile appand its integration with our GraphQL API. You’ll play a pivotal role in ensuring rapid, regression-free delivery across iOS, Android, and Shorebird OTA updates for millions of students.

In this role, you will champion the "new generation" of quality engineering. Beyond traditional test automation, you will leverage modern AI coding assistants (such as Cursor, Copilot, ChatGPT, Claude, and Gemini) as your primary force multiplier to achieve maximum test coverage at unmatched speed. Working closely with mobile and backend teams across a modern multi-service architecture, you will shift quality left, auditing Figma specs before sprint commitments, reviewing PRs, and maintaining continuous quality gates in our CI/CD pipelines.

What You’ll Do

  • End-to-End Web Automation: Build, maintain, and execute parallelized E2E smoke and regression test pipelines using Patrol integrated directly into Codemagic and GitLab CI pipeline.

  • API & Contract QA: Establish automated contract and API integration testing to validate GraphQL schema updates against mobile query requirements, guaranteeing zero breaking changes.

  • AI Integration: Deeply integrate AI tools (Cursor, Copilot, ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini) into daily workflows to generate Patrol scripts directly from Figma specs, synthesize complex mock payloads, and automate log triage to double QA efficiency.

  • Shift-Left Quality Champion: Review feature specs in Figma and GraphQL schema definitions early to catch edge cases, logic gaps, and design flaws before sprint commitments and development begin. Participate actively in PR reviews.

  • System Observability & Triage: Monitor build health, Firebase Remote Config/Analytics, Sentry error logs, and GCP Cloud Run logs to triage issues across Flutter BLoC/UI state, GraphQL resolvers, and backend services, logging rich GitLab issues with dev-ready context.

  • Exploratory & Release Testing: Conduct testing across iOS Simulators, Android Emulators, physical devices, TestFlight, Google Play Console internal tracks, and Shorebird OTA hot-patches.

  • Component Testing: Utilize Flutter Storybook to conduct visual regression and component-level testing early in the release lifecycle.


Required Qualifications (Must Haves)

  • Experience Level: 3+ years of professional experience in Mobile QA Engineering / Test Automation, with at least 1+ year actively incorporating AI coding tools into daily workflows.

  • Mobile Automation Mastery: Hands-on experience with Flutter automation frameworks (Patrol, Flutter Integration Test, or strong Appium/XCUITest/Espresso skills with eager readiness to master Patrol).

  • API & Schema Verification: Proficiency in testing GraphQL APIs (Bruno, Postman, Playwright, or HTTP clients), including schema validation, headers, and JWT auth flows.

  • Mobile Ecosystem & Design: Comfort inspecting Figma files for UI specs/design tokens, using Xcode/Android Studio tools, managing Firebase Remote Config & feature flags, and navigating mobile app deployment lifecycles (Apple App Store / TestFlight, Google Play Console internal testing).

  • CI/CD & Mobile DevOps: Experience with mobile CI/CD tools (Codemagic, GitLab CI) and Git/GitLab workflows.

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent practical experience in software development / test automation.

  • Communication: Clear, concise async communication skills in written and spoken English for bug reporting, documentation, and remote collaboration.

Nice to Have

  • AI-Native Focus: Advanced proficiency loading architecture specs, GraphQL schemas, and UI design tokens into AI models to auto-generate test cases, Patrol page objects, and mock payloads.

  • Dart & Component Testing: Direct Dart / Flutter coding ability to write unit and widget tests in-repo, as well as Flutter Storybook experience.

  • OTA & Scripting: Experience with Shorebird (OTA hot patching for Flutter) or basic TypeScript / Bun experience for writing Bruno test collections or schema scripts.

  • Cloud Infrastructure & Feature Flags: Exposure to GCP (Cloud Run, Cloud Logging) and Unleash feature flag management.

  • Certifications: Certifications in Quality Engineering, Mobile Testing, or AI-Assisted Software Engineering.

Bonus Skills (The "X-Factor")

  • Cross-Platform & GraphQL Experience: Prior experience testing cross-platform Flutter applications connected to GraphQL backends in fast-paced product companies.

description: About the role Gauss Fusion is aiming to build the first commercial scale fusion power plant based on the stellarator concept and is seeking an experienced mechanical engineer to lead on development of the robotic maintenance approach. The fusion environment within the reactor is very aggressive, and in-vessel components such as the breeder blanket and divertor will need to be replaced on a regular basis as the materials become damaged by the radiation. Due to the environment inside the device, and in order to maintain a high overall availability, the maintenance must be done robotically using automated systems to extract and replace the components and bring the removed ones to a hot cell for separation, waste treatment, and recycling. Gauss Fusion is looking for an innovative mechanical design engineer with experience in robotics to lead the work defining and developing the maintenance approach for the Gauss stellarator power plant and its key stellarator systems. While the magnetic configuration will be designed to maximise access to the reactor, the complex geometry poses a challenge to fixations and kinematics, and inventive approaches to the problem are required. Main responsibilities Manage the Gauss Fusion maintenance approach to meet the requirements of a commercial scale fusion power plant design: Develop workable approaches to achieving high power plant availability, taking account of engineering and physics requirements across the reactor. Integrate these remote maintenance requirements into plant layout specifications. Define approaches to minimising hot cell inventory through efficient handling of removed components. Lead development of the breeder blanket and divertor segmentation and fixations resulting from these approaches. Lead development of remote maintenance testing and demonstration systems for the reactor. Qualification and educational requirements Bachelor’s degree in mechanical engineering or related field, master’s or Ph.D. preferred. Technical experience: Minimum of 6 years of experience in mechanical engineering, preferably in large-scale engineering projects. Experience in designing complex mechanical systems, preferably in the energy or nuclear industry. Familiarity with CAD software and engineering analysis tools. Competences and preferred skills Experience developing remote maintenance systems operating in hazardous environments Strong background in mechatronics, motion control and mechanical integration. Experience with digital mock-up will be an asset Familiarity with maintenance, inspection and intervention systems Familiarity with system engineering processes, requirements management and verification activities. Strong understanding of mechanical design principles and engineering mechanics. Proficiency in structural analysis, finite element analysis (FEA), and kinematic analysis. Ability to manage multidisciplinary teams and coordinate with other engineering disciplines. Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail. Main responsibilities

Manage the Gauss Fusion maintenance approach to meet the requirements of a commercial scale fusion power plant design:

  • Develop workable approaches to achieving high power plant availability, taking account of engineering and physics requirements across the reactor.
  • Integrate these remote maintenance requirements into plant layout specifications.
  • Define approaches to minimising hot cell inventory through efficient handling of removed components.
  • Lead development of the breeder blanket and divertor segmentation and fixations resulting from these approaches.
  • Lead development of remote maintenance testing and demonstration systems for the reactor.


Qualification and educational requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in mechanical engineering or related field, master’s or Ph.D. preferred.
  • Technical experience: 
    • Minimum of 6 years of experience in mechanical engineering, preferably in large-scale engineering projects.
    • Experience in designing complex mechanical systems, preferably in the energy or nuclear industry.
    • Familiarity with CAD software and engineering analysis tools.


Competences and preferred skills

  • Experience developing remote maintenance systems operating in hazardous environments

  • Familiarity with maintenance, inspection and intervention systems

title: Managing Director / Country Head (m/w/d) Deutschland
description: Bereit, den Markt zu verändern? PAIR Finance denkt Inkasso neu: Wir entwickeln die fortschrittlichste KI-Technologie im Forderungsmanagement und haben damit die gesamte Inkassoindustrie nachhaltig verändert. Heute sind wir mit 250+ Mitarbeitenden, 600+ Mandant*innen und Standorten in zehn europäischen Städten europaweit führend im Einsatz von KI im Forderungsmanagement – und erzielen dabei höhere Rückzahlungsquoten, ohne die Kundenbeziehung unserer Mandant*innen zu belasten. Im Zuge der Ausgliederung entsteht die PAIR Finance Deutschland GmbH als eigenständige operative Gesellschaft für unseren Heimatmarkt. Als Managing Director / Country Head (m/w/d) Deutschland übernimmst du die unternehmerische und vertriebliche Verantwortung für diesen Aufbau: Deutschland ist der am weitesten entwickelte Markt unserer europaweit tätigen Gruppe – deine Aufgabe ist es, ihn weiter zu skalieren, zu professionalisieren und profitabel auszubauen. Du gestaltest die nächste Wachstumsphase der deutschen Gesellschaft aktiv mit. Was du bei uns bewegen kannst: Umsatz- und Ergebnisverantwortung für den Standort Deutschland: Du steuerst Vertrieb und Neukundenakquise aktiv, verantwortest Pipeline und Forecast und triffst die zentralen kommerziellen Entscheidungen für den deutschen Markt. Entwicklung und Umsetzung der Vertriebsstrategie für den deutschen Markt , inklusive Priorisierung unserer Schwerpunktindustrien (E-Commerce, Medien & Entertainment, Banken & Versicherungen, Mobility, Energieversorger) und – in Abstimmung mit der Gruppe – dem Einsatz gezielter Collection-Strategien. Akquise neuer Mandant*innen sowie systematischer Ausbau bestehender Partnerschaften: du trägst die Verantwortung für ambitionierte Neugeschäfts- und Wachstumsziele. Führung und Weiterentwicklung eines vertriebsstarken, motivierten Teams mit klarer Ziel- und Ergebnisorientierung. Enge Zusammenarbeit mit dem C-Level der Gruppe und den internationalen Country MDs, um pan-europäische Kunden für PAIR Finance zu gewinnen, Vertriebs-Best-Practices gruppenweit zu teilen und Vertriebsstrategien europaweit auszurollen. Positionierung von PAIR Finance am deutschen Markt zur Unterstützung deiner Vertriebsziele – z. B. durch Pressemitteilungen, eigene Vorträge und Auftritte auf Konferenzen, Messen und Webinaren, sowie Weiterentwicklung der Marketingstrategie und Organisation von Kundenevents. Rechtskonformität am Standort: Sicherstellung in enger Abstimmung mit der zentralen Legal & Compliance-Funktion, die hierfür die fachliche Verantwortung trägt. Hinweis zum Geschäftsmodell: Unsere Mandant*innen (deine Kunden im Vertrieb) sind ausschließlich Unternehmen – vom E-Commerce-Player bis zum Energieversorger. Die eigentliche Forderungsbearbeitung richtet sich an Endverbraucher*innen (B2C). Dein Vertrieb ist also klassisches Enterprise-B2B-Geschäft. Was du dafür mitbringen solltest: Mehrjährige, hochrangige Vertriebsführungserfahrung im B2B-Umfeld mit nachweisbaren Vertriebs- und Wachstumserfolgen (z. B. als Sales Director, Head of Sales oder Country Manager), idealerweise im FinTech-Bereich oder in einem regulierten Umfeld wie Inkasso, Forderungsmanagement oder Financial Services Nachweisbare Erfolge im Aufbau und in der Skalierung von B2B-Vertriebsorganisationen – inklusive Verantwortung für Umsatzziele, Pipeline-Steuerung und Forecasting Belastbares, kommerziell nutzbares Netzwerk zu Entscheider*innen in unseren Schlüsselbranchen (E-Commerce, Medien & Entertainment, Banken & Versicherungen, Mobility, Energieversorger) Hohe Kundenorientierung und ausgeprägte Hands-on-Vertriebsmentalität – du gehst selbst aktiv auf Mandant*innen zu Klare, glaubwürdige und zielgruppengerechte Kommunikation Schnelle Auffassungsgabe und starke analytische Fähigkeiten Echtes Interesse an Technologie und der Anwendung von KI Verhandlungssichere Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse Transparenz, Ownership, Execution, Kundenzentrierung, Innovation und Integrität sind für uns bei PAIR Finance keine Worte, sondern gelebte Praxis. Wir sind ein technologiegetriebenes Unternehmen und setzen KI täglich aktiv ein, um effizienter zu arbeiten und jeden Tag ein bisschen erfolgreicher zu sein. Wir suchen Kolleg*innen, die diese Neugier teilen, mit kreativem Denken neue Wege ausprobieren und Lust haben, Dinge anders zu machen. Erkennst du dich darin wieder? Dann werde Teil unseres Teams und bring deine Vertriebsstärke, Motivation und Persönlichkeit ein. Was wir dir bieten: Culture & Team PAIR Finance zählt zu den am stärksten wachsenden Fintechs in Europa. Heute sind wir mit 250+ Mitarbeitenden, 600+ Mandant*innen und Standorten in zehn europäischen Städten europaweit führend im Einsatz von KI im Forderungsmanagement – und erzielen dabei höhere Rückzahlungsquoten, ohne die Kundenbeziehung unserer Mandant*innen zu belasten.

  • Positionierung von PAIR Finance am deutschen Markt zur Unterstützung deiner Vertriebsziele – z. B. durch Pressemitteilungen, eigene Vorträge und Auftritte auf Konferenzen, Messen und Webinaren, sowie Weiterentwicklung der Marketingstrategie und Organisation von Kundenevents.

Hinweis zum Geschäftsmodell: Unsere Mandant*innen (deine Kunden im Vertrieb) sind ausschließlich Unternehmen – vom E-Commerce-Player bis zum Energieversorger. title: Senior Frontend Engineer - React
description: ResearchGate is the professional network for scientists and researchers. From climate change and emerging diseases to food security and the responsible development of AI, the challenges facing our world are complex. Still, we’re optimistic about the power of millions of scientists working together to tackle them. We provide scientists with the help and support they need by connecting them to the world’s most active scientific community. We've built a platform that gives the world's scientists the tools and services they need to connect, collaborate, and advance their research. Over 25 million members from 193 countries use ResearchGate to share, discover, and discuss research. Objective of the role We're looking for an enthusiastic frontend engineer with the skills and ability to turn great ideas into reality. You should have an in-depth understanding of current web technologies and front-end development, and be passionate about creating a great user experience. Your input will help us grow and maintain our React front-end. Join a team that encourages you to explore, learn, and go beyond, while seeing your work lead to actionable results. Put your creative problem-solving and development skills into action and make a positive impact on science and society. This is a full-time position based in Germany. The team You will be an integral part of the product team dedicated to enhancing ResearchGate's publisher-facing product. This role involves designing, constructing, and refining the platform to further our mission of facilitating global scientific connections and ensuring open access to research. At present, our team is working on making ResearchGate a great platform for publishers to connect with existing and future authors. Your immediate colleagues will consist of JavaScript and PHP engineers, an Engineering Manager, a Product Manager, a UX Designer, and a UX Writer. Our team places great value on our collaborative and communicative work culture and we eagerly anticipate integrating a new Engineer into this environment. Responsibilites Create web interfaces using TypeScript and React for new products and features. Seamlessly integrate our front-end with our back-end world using GraphQL and PHP. Maintain and improve existing features and related infrastructure. Collaborate with Product Managers, Designers, and Software Engineers to deliver compelling publisher-facing products. Requirements 5+ years frontend web development experience in TypeScript (React), CSS Demonstrated ability to create code that is easily comprehensible, maintainable, and testable. Eagerness to acquire new skills, delve into different technologies and programming languages, and a willingness to acknowledge areas where expertise may be lacking. Approach problem-solving thoughtfully, embracing curiosity and maintaining an open-minded perspective. You are comfortable incorporating AI-assisted development tools into your daily workflow and exercise strong engineering judgment when evaluating and refining their output. Knowledge of GraphQL. It would be a plus if you already had knowledge of relational and document-based databases (we use MongoDB and Postgres). What we're looking for You take responsibility over your own solutions and continuously improve them. You engage in proactive and efficient communication within our distributed work environment. You focus on building a great product. You excel at designing and creating coherent, user-centric interfaces that display complex information. The interview process We start with a short call with HR or an Engineering Manager to align on the details of the job inquiry. There will be a longer discussion about your technical and professional experience and expectations with an Engineering Manager and another colleague. We’ll facilitate a technical interview with one or two engineers with some pair programming and technical discussion. You'll have a conversation with our VP of Product, Mark, and our VP of Engineering, Frank, to learn more about our product and engineering organization and discuss how your experience aligns with our goals. Last but not least, you will meet with our CEO, Ijad, and our VP of Finance & People team, Jess. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

Du kennst sowohl die Arbeit auf Teamebene als auch die Koordination über mehrere Teams hinweg, idealerweise ergänzt durch Erfahrung in interkulturellen Kontexten.

  • Forschung & Entwicklung. Stecke deine Nase bewusst auch in andere Themen rein.

We deliver on-demand and private GPU infrastructure to teams who treat performance as a requirement, not a feature.</p> <p>We’re a tight-knit, fast-moving team working at the cutting edge of AI cloud infrastructure. We practise what we preach, equipping our people with AI at every level so we can solve harder problems, ship faster, and keep raising the bar for what enterprise GPU infrastructure looks like.</p> <h2>THE ROLE: Solutions Architect</h2> <p>This role exists because our pipeline of technically complex, high-value GPU cloud opportunities is growing — and winning them requires more than a great sales team. The Solutions Architect sits at the intersection of sales, infrastructure, and the customer, translating complex workload requirements into technically sound, commercially viable solutions on the Hyperstack platform.</p> <p>You’ll be the primary technical authority through the sales cycle: engaging directly with prospective and existing customers, producing detailed solution designs, and ensuring that what is proposed can actually be delivered to the standard committed. This is a role for someone who is equally comfortable in a customer meeting and a technical design review — someone who earns trust through depth, not slides.</p> <h2>WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING</h2> <p>Rather than a long checklist, here’s what success in this role looks like:</p> <ul> <li>Own the technical sales cycle end-to-end — from initial customer brief through architecture design, proposal, and delivery handover — acting as the primary technical authority for GPU cloud solution design.</li> <li>Engage directly with prospective and existing customers to understand workload requirements, technical constraints, and commercial objectives, producing detailed solution designs including architecture diagrams, network topology, storage configurations, and GPU resource allocation models.</li> <li>Collaborate closely with Pre-Sales Engineering, Data Centre, Infrastructure, and Network Engineering teams to validate delivery feasibility before commitments are made to customers.</li> <li>Build and maintain a library of reference architectures and solution templates spanning AI/ML training, inference, HPC, and rendering workloads — accelerating the sales cycle and improving proposal consistency across the team.</li> <li>Develop high-quality technical proposals, RFP responses, and statements of work, supporting commercial discussions with clear scoping, realistic estimates, and honest risk assessments.</li> <li>Define and maintain comprehensive Bills of Materials (BoMs) for all proposed solutions, ensuring accuracy for procurement, provisioning, and margin review.</li> <li>Feed back recurring customer requirements and competitive intelligence to engineering leadership, directly influencing the Hyperstack product roadmap.</li> </ul> <h2>ABOUT YOU</h2> <p>We’re more interested in how you think and work than in a perfect CV. You’ll likely come from an HPC, AI infrastructure, or high-performance cloud background and bring a combination of the following:</p> <h3>Essential</h3> <ul> <li>Proven experience in HPC or AI software stack design and delivery at scale — including workload profiling, scheduler configuration (SLURM, PBS, or equivalent), MPI/NCCL tuning, and distributed training frameworks such as PyTorch, JAX, or DeepSpeed.</li> <li>Deep understanding of GPU software environments: CUDA, cuDNN, NCCL, driver stacks, and the tooling required to run large-scale AI training and inference workloads reliably in production.</li> <li>Hands-on experience optimising AI and HPC workloads across multi-GPU and multi-node configurations — including profiling, bottleneck identification, and performance tuning at both the application and infrastructure layer.</li> <li>Strong working knowledge of containerisation and orchestration in HPC/AI contexts: Docker, Kubernetes, NVIDIA GPU Operator, and container-native workload management.</li> <li>Background in an OEM, hyperscaler, neo-cloud, or enterprise/research HPC environment, with demonstrable exposure to the full design-to-deployment lifecycle for GPU-accelerated workloads.</li> <li>Ability to produce clear, professional technical documentation and architecture diagrams suitable for both engineering and board-level audiences.</li> <li>Confident engaging with customers, vendors, and internal engineering teams as a technical authority — able to translate complex software and performance trade-offs into clear, actionable decisions.</li> </ul> infrastructure teams on topology and tuning decisions.</li> <li>Commercial awareness: experience contributing to BoMs, technical proposals, or RFP responses in a pre-sales or customer-facing technical role.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h2>WHAT WE OFFER</h2> <ul> <li>Competitive salary and annual discretionary bonus scheme.</li> <li>Employee wellbeing benefits.</li> <li>25 days of holiday, plus public on some of our most strategically important opportunities.</li> <li>The chance to work at the cutting edge of GPU cloud infrastructure, with a platform purpose-built for AI, ML and HPC workloads.</li> <li>Clear career progression and growth opportunities in a fast-growing company.</li> <li>A collaborative, international culture built on trust, transparency, and ownership.</li> <li>The opportunity to shape how NexGen Cloud is positioned and perceived in a competitive and fast-moving market.</li> </ul> <h2>MORE INFORMATION</h2> <p>Head over to our <a description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>Recruitment Fraud Alert</strong></p> <p>We’ve learned that scammers are impersonating Commvault team members—including HR and leadership—via email or text. These bad actors may conduct fake interviews and ask for personal information, such as your social security number. &nbsp;</p> <p><strong>What to know:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Commvault does&nbsp;<em>not</em>&nbsp;conduct interviews by email or text.</li> <li>We will never ask you to submit sensitive documents (including banking information, SSN, etc) before your first day.</li> <li>Commvault recruiters may contact prospective candidates through LinkedIn and other professional networking platforms regarding career opportunities. If you are unsure whether a recruiting communication is legitimate, review the profile to ensure they have a badge verifying them as a Commvault employee.</li> </ul> <p>If you suspect a recruiting scam, please contact us at <u><a ---------- <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>About Commvault</strong>&nbsp;</p> <p>Commvault (NASDAQ: CVLT) is the gold standard in cyber resilience. The company empowers customers to uncover, take action, and rapidly recover from cyberattacks – keeping data safe and businesses resilient. The company’s unique AI-powered platform combines best-in-class data protection, exceptional data security, advanced data intelligence, and lightning-fast recovery across any workload or cloud at the lowest TCO. For over 25 years, more than 100,000 organizations and a vast partner ecosystem have relied on Commvault to reduce risks, improve governance, and do more with data.&nbsp;</p></div><p>The Cloud Resilience Account Executive (CRAE) is responsible for achieving quota by selling Commvault Cloud SaaS solutions in cloud-centric environments (AWS, Azure, GCP) into a defined territory that includes current Commvault customers and prospects. The position is an overlay field sales role where the CRAE is responsible for supporting Enterprise and Commercial Segment Account Executives face to face or virtually on sales meetings. This role will align to multiple Sales Leaders, supporting opportunities from their territories and leading specific stages during the sales process (e.g. demos, POCs, TCO discussions, etc).&nbsp;&nbsp;</p> <p>The CRAE must have the ability to articulate an in-depth discussion, starting from understanding the end user’s cloud environment, current challenges/goals, and align Commvault SaaS solutions to those challenges/goals including a financial and strategic value proposition.&nbsp;&nbsp;</p> <p>The ideal candidate will demonstrate a strong hunter mentality and expertise in managing complex sales cycles from prospecting to purchase order closure. Further the ideal candidate must have a history of success in selling software platforms (SaaS preferred) and have experience selling alongside cloud system integrators and hyperscalers.</p> <p><strong>What you’ll do…</strong>&nbsp;</p> <ul> <li>Generate and qualify leads that cover cloud native workloads and data security, and help field sellers in developing business opportunities in order to achieve their SaaS quota on a quarterly and annual basis&nbsp;</li> <li>Maintain a high level of face-to-face and/or virtual meeting activity with customers, prospects, cloud system integrators, and hyperscalers in alignment with the guidance and priorities received from the Sales Leaders (AVPs and Sales Directors)&nbsp;</li> <li>Partner with Commvault field sellers and pre-sales engineers to lead opportunities and work jointly to closure&nbsp;</li> <li>Be able to coach and share best practices with the broader sales and GTM organization&nbsp;</li> <li>Foster strategic working relationships with customers, maintaining a high level of contact&nbsp;</li> </ul> <ul> <li>Work collaboratively with product and marketing teams to develop targeted campaigns that resonate with cloud-native and security personas to maximize sales success</li> </ul> <ul> <li>Prepare and present sales proposals and presentations to prospects and existing customers with quantifiable business cases and technical value propositions&nbsp;</li> <li>Provide support in negotiating and closing deals following the company’s practices and processes&nbsp;</li> <li>Leverage internal sales tools and processes to help drive opportunities to a successful close&nbsp;and onboarding alongside customer success</li> <li>Plan, attend, coordinate, follow up on next steps from executive briefings&nbsp;</li> <li>Maintain a high level of relevant cloud, data security, and competitive knowledge&nbsp;</li> <li>Be able to take responsibility of the SaaS goal for your territory, accurately forecast the business, and hold to that commitment&nbsp;&nbsp;</li> <li>Be the owner of your business in your territory, ensuring end-to-end management of the identified specific SaaS services (including sales activities, forecast, planning, reporting, QBRs, etc.)&nbsp;</li> </ul> <p><strong>Who you are…</strong>&nbsp;</p> <ul> <li>Bachelor's degree or equivalent working experience&nbsp;</li> <li>Minimum of 5+ years’ demonstrated success in software or SaaS sales, cloud (AWS, Azure, GCP) and/or cyber security experience preferred</li> <li>Understanding of the SaaS data management industry, products, competitors, history, emerging trends and changing marketplace&nbsp;</li> <li>Minimum of two years’ success in identifying, building relationships and selling with cloud system integrators partners&nbsp;</li> <li>Excellent communication skills, persuasive, listening skills&nbsp;</li> <li>Strong financial selling skills, specifically building and delivering TCO models&nbsp;</li> <li>Experience working with RTM (routes to market) like cloud system integrators, hyperscalers, alliances and global system integrators&nbsp;</li> <li>MEDDICC knowledge and participation in account planning activities&nbsp;</li> <li>Strong working relationship with legal to accelerate agreements required for closure</li> <li>Experience selling solutions through public cloud marketplaces&nbsp;&nbsp;</li> </ul> <p>#LI-EL1</p> <p>#LI-remote</p><div class="content-conclusion"><div class="jd-info au-target" data-ph-at-id="jobdescription-text" data-ph-id="ph-page-element-page5-4e8TMw"> <p>Commvault is an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are always committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status and we will not discriminate against on the basis of such characteristics or any other status protected by the laws or regulations in the locations where we work.</p> <p>Commvault’s goal is to make interviewing inclusive and accessible to all candidates and employees.
