More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.</p> <p>The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values&nbsp;and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OuZIb5zszQI">Co-create the future with us</a> as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.</p> <p>*<em>Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><h2>An overview of this role</h2> <p>Aa Senior Account Executive, you’ll be the primary connection between GitLab and our Commercial &amp; Enterprise customers, working with organizations of up to 4,000 team members to help them adopt and expand the world’s most comprehensive AI-powered DevSecOps platform. You’ll own a broad book of business across a wide range of opportunity sizes, guiding small, fast-growing teams as well as more complex projects as they modernize their software delivery with GitLab. Reporting to an Area Sales Manager and partnering closely with business development, marketing, and technical teams, you’ll run the full sales process: shaping the customer’s journey, documenting buying criteria and processes, ensuring accurate pipeline based on evidence, and sharing root-cause insights on wins and losses. In your first year, you’ll focus on building trusted relationships, delivering meaningful business outcomes for customers, and being the voice of the customer internally by contributing ideas to our public issue tracker and improving our sales handbook.</p> <h2>What you’ll do</h2> <ul> <li value="1">Report to an Regional Sales Director and own a broad book of Commercial &amp; Enterprise business, from new prospects to growing existing accounts.</li> <li value="2">Manage the full sales cycle for Commercial &amp; Enterprise prospects, from discovery and solution alignment through negotiation and close.</li> <li value="3">Support GitLab for Commercial &amp; Enterprise prospects by clearly articulating our DevSecOps value proposition and aligning it to customer business outcomes.</li> <li value="4">Analyze wins and losses, contribute to root cause analyses, and share lessons learned with account managers, marketing, and technical teams.</li> <li value="5">Document and maintain accurate buying criteria, buying processes, next steps, and owners to ensure a reliable, evidence-based pipeline.</li> <li value="6">Contribute to improving our sales handbook and processes by documenting best practices and opportunities for refinement.</li> <li value="7">Provide account leadership and direction across pre- and post-sales, partnering closely with technical teams and customer success.</li> <li value="8">Represent the voice of the customer by contributing product feedback and ideas to our public issue tracker.</li> </ul> <h2>What you’ll bring</h2> <ul> <li value="1">Proven success in software sales, ideally in a Enterprise market context, managing a varied book of business.</li> <li value="2">Ability to guide customers through the full buying journey, including defining buying criteria, mapping buying processes, and driving clear next steps.</li> <li value="3">Effective communication and interpersonal skills to collaborate with business development, marketing, technical teams, and sales management.</li> <li value="4">Experience documenting and maintaining accurate pipeline data and account plans based on evidence rather than assumptions.</li> <li value="5">Skill in conducting and contributing to win/loss and root cause analyses, and sharing insights to improve team performance and processes.</li> <li value="6">Proficiency in negotiation, presenting to customer stakeholders, and leading commercial discussions to close opportunities.</li> <li value="7">Interest in GitLab, open source software, and preferably familiarity with Git, software development tools, or application lifecycle management.</li> <li value="8">Alignment with GitLab’s values and an interest in contributing from diverse or transferable sales backgrounds, with willingness to travel in line with company policy.</li> </ul> <h2>About the team</h2> <p>The Commercial &amp; Enterprise Sales team focuses on helping growing organizations adopt and expand GitLab’s AI-powered DevSecOps We focus on opportunities like supporting customers through toolchain consolidation, driving platform adoption, and sharing learnings from wins and losses to continuously improve how we sell and support GitLab.</p> <p><span style="color: rgb(236, 240, 241);">#LI-CW1</span></p><div class="content-conclusion"><h4><strong>How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees</strong></h4> <ul> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/">Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/time-off-and-absence/time-off-types/#flexible-paid-time-off-pto">Flexible Paid Time Off&nbsp;</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/company/culture/inclusion/tmrg-tmag/">Team Member Resource Groups</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/stock-options/">Equity Compensation &amp; Employee Stock Purchase Plan</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/learning-and-development/growth-and-development/">Growth and Development Fund</a></li> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/#parental-leave">Parental Leave</a>&nbsp;</li> </ul> <p>Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement. Our Talent Acquisition team can help answer any questions about location after starting the recruiting process.&nbsp;&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Privacy Policy: </strong>Please review our <a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/hiring/candidate-faq/recruitment-privacy-policy/" target="_blank">Recruitment Privacy Policy.</a> Your privacy is important to us.</p> <p>GitLab is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. title: Director, International Privacy Lead and Data Protection Officer
description: <p><strong>Director, International Privacy Lead &amp; Data Protection Officer</strong></p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Overview</strong></p> <p>Alnylam is seeking an experienced privacy and data protection leader to serve as Director, International Privacy Lead &amp; Data Protection Officer. Reporting to the Senior Director, Head of Privacy, AI Governance, Training &amp; Communications within Ethics &amp; Compliance, this role will lead Alnylam’s international privacy program, with primary responsibility for Europe (EU/EEA, United Kingdom, and Switzerland) and support for broader international markets.</p> <p>As Alnylam’s formally appointed Data Protection Officer (DPO) under applicable European and Swiss privacy laws, the Director will provide independent privacy oversight, advise the business on data protection obligations, and maintain direct access and escalation channels to senior leadership for material privacy risks.</p> <p>This individual contributor will be expected to serve as a proactive partner to the our international business, anticipating privacy and data protection obligations driven by regulatory change and business growth, and translating those requirements into actionable guidance for policies, operations and ways of working.</p> <p>The successful candidate will partner closely with Legal, Information Security, IT, HR, Commercial, Medical Affairs, Clinical Development, Pharmacovigilance, Procurement, Ethics &amp; Compliance, and other business stakeholders to enable responsible use of personal data while strengthening privacy governance, risk management, and business adoption across international markets.</p> <p>Hybrid role preferably based in Zug, Switzerland.&nbsp;Also open to candidates based in Madrid, Spain or Maidenhead, UK.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Responsibilities</strong></p> <ul> <li>Lead and mature Alnylam’s international privacy program, with primary focus on Europe and support for broader international markets, by setting program priorities, strengthening governance frameworks, and ensuring privacy requirements are embedded into business planning, policies, controls, and day-to-day operations.</li> <li>Serve as Alnylam’s appointed DPO under EU GDPR, UK GDPR, and applicable Swiss data protection requirements, providing independent advice, monitoring compliance, maintaining required independence, and acting as the primary point of contact for supervisory authorities and data subjects.</li> <li>Oversee privacy risk identification, assessment, mitigation, monitoring, and escalation processes, including privacy-by-design and privacy-by-default requirements, DPIAs, TIAs, Records of Processing Activities (ROPA), cross-border transfer assessments, and related governance documentation.</li> <li>Advise business and functional leaders on privacy requirements related to clinical research, pharmacovigilance, commercial operations, medical affairs, human resources, patient support programs, real-world evidence, AI, and other data-driven initiatives.</li> <li>Partner with Information Security, Legal, Procurement, and business stakeholders on privacy incident response, breach assessment, third-party privacy risk management, data protection terms, data sharing arrangements, remediation, and regulatory notification decisions.</li> <li>Proactively monitor the European and international privacy, AI, digital, cyber and data governance legislative landscape, anticipating compliance impacts from business growth and regulatory change, and rapidly translating new or changing requirements into practical updates to policies, controls, business processes, training, and operational guidance.</li> <li>Develop and deliver privacy training, communications, awareness initiatives, metrics, monitoring activities, and continuous improvement plans that promote a culture of privacy and accountability across international markets.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Qualifications</strong></p> <p><strong>Required</strong></p> <ul> <li>Juris Doctor (JD), LLM, or other advanced legal degree required.</li> <li>12+ years of privacy legal or compliance experience at a law firm and/or in-house.</li> <li>Significant experience advising on privacy risk in regulated life sciences settings, including clinical research, pharmacovigilance, medical affairs, commercial, HR, patient-facing, and digital activities.</li> <li>Experience serving as a DPO or advising in an equivalent independent oversight capacity for GDPR, UK GDPR, Swiss FADP, or comparable privacy regimes.</li> <li>Deep understanding of GDPR, UK GDPR, Swiss FADP, international data transfer requirements, and global privacy regulations.</li> <li>Experience advising on AI, data-driven innovation, real-world evidence, cross-border data use, and other strategic privacy initiatives.</li> <li>Strong privacy governance and risk management experience, including the ability to set priorities, mature program controls, and translate complex requirements into practical guidance for technical and non-technical audiences.</li> <li>Strong executive communication, stakeholder management, and influencing skills, with the credibility and judgment to engage senior leaders, regulators, external partners, and cross-functional stakeholders.</li> <li>Proven ability to lead complex privacy initiatives across matrixed, international organizations, applying practical and proportionate judgment to ambiguous issues.</li> <li>Executive presence, regulatory credibility, and strategic judgment to anticipate legal, business, and technology shifts and translate them into clear priorities for the international privacy program.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Preferred</strong></p> <ul> <li>Privacy certifications such as CIPP/E, CIPM, CIPT, AIGP, or similar credentials preferred.</li> <li>Experience interacting directly with European data protection authorities and regulators preferred.</li> <li>Experience leading multinational privacy teams or global privacy programs preferred.</li> <li>International business experience within a global life sciences organization preferred.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>About Alnylam:&nbsp;</strong>Alnylam Pharmaceuticals (Nasdaq: ALNY) has led the translation of RNA interference (RNAi) into a whole new class of innovative medicines with the potential to transform the lives of people afflicted with rare and more prevalent diseases. Based on Nobel Prize-winning science, RNAi therapeutics represent a powerful, clinically validated approach to treating diseases at their genetic source by “interfering” with mRNA that cause or contribute to disease. Since our founding in 2002, Alnylam has led the RNAi Revolution and continues to turn scientific possibility into reality.</p> <p><strong>Our culture:</strong>&nbsp;Our people-first culture is guided by our core values: fiercely innovative, open culture, purposeful urgency, passion for excellence, and commitment to people, and these values influence how we work and the business decisions we make. Thanks to feedback from our employees over the years, we’ve been fortunate to be named a top employer around the world. Alnylam is extremely proud to have been recognized as one of Science Magazine’s Top Biopharma Employers, one of America's Most Responsible Companies for 2024 by Newsweek, a Fast Company Best Workplace for Innovators, and a Great Place to Work in Canada, France, Italy, Spain, Switzerland, and UK – among others.</p> <p>At Alnylam, we commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equal employment opportunity. We are dedicated to building an environment where employees can feel that they belong, can bring their authentic selves to work, and achieve to their full potential. By empowering employees to embrace their unique differences at work, our business grows stronger with advanced and original thinking, allowing us to bring groundbreaking medicines to patients.</p> <p>Before applying, please review Alnylam's ⁠Candidate&nbsp;<a href="https://alnylampolicies.com/">Privacy Notice</a>&nbsp;regarding how Alnylam handles Personal Data you provide with your application for employment.</p> Find more English Speaking Jobs in Switzerland on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Web Compatibility Engineer
description: Who We Are Hi, we're DuckDuckGo, the online protection company and remote-first team of 300+ on a mission to raise the standard of trust online. Founded in 2008 and profitable since 2014, annual revenue now exceeds $100m USD and millions use our browser on Mac , Windows , iOS , and Android , our search engine , and the latest — Privacy Pro . Our culture of trust, inclusivity, and empowered project management underpins everything we do, where each team member takes full ownership of their projects, from scoping and execution to postmortem. If you're seeking end-to-end ownership of your work — you've come to the right place! Your Team and Role Working on the Web Dependability Engineering team, you'll make sure websites just work in DuckDuckGo's browsers across Mac, Windows, iOS, and Android, helping ensure our users have the best-possible experience browsing with DuckDuckGo. Recent projects include: Reverse-engineering how sites detect our privacy protections and building countermeasures that keep pages working Shimming browser APIs so sites work seamlessly across different browser engines and system webviews Building LLM agent pipelines that automatically reproduce and triage reported site breakage As a Senior Web Compatibility Engineer , you'll be our resident expert on why websites break and how to fix them: owning the webcompat side of our triage process, debugging gnarly issues in code you don't control, distinguishing site bugs from browser bugs from privacy protection-induced breakage, leading the charge when a top site breaks and becomes an incident, shipping durable fixes across every platform, and work on related projects that prevent user churn and keep users coming back to DuckDuckGo. About You 7+ years of experience building and debugging complex web applications with vanilla JavaScript. Detailed knowledge of web standards, web components, and browser APIs. Any additional experience with our stack is a bonus: Swift/Kotlin/C#/C++/Python. Advanced ability to reverse-engineer obfuscated third-party code and reduce issues to minimal test cases. Passion for hunting elusive bugs and tracing them to their root cause. Interest in automating repetitive work and building agentic tooling that multiplies the team's impact. Experience triaging issues, leading incident response, and communicating clearly with technical and non-technical stakeholders. Experience shipping code beyond the web, like native or desktop clients. Ability to lead complex, ambiguous projects with little to no oversight. Compensation $178,500 USD annually and stock options. Compensation is identical within professional levels , regardless of geographic location or team. Compensation for each professional level is transparent across the organization. Eligibility for company-sponsored health benefits is limited to team members based in the United States. This program does not extend to team members located in other countries, such as Canada or the UK. Our Team Member Support Guide explains how we prioritize your wellbeing including paid parental leave, office setup, and co-working allowances. Hiring Process Hiring works best when it's a two-way street. Learn how we help you get to know DuckDuckGo, envision your future role here, and find out more about how we hire . Diversity, Equity and Inclusion DuckDuckGo provides equal work opportunities to all team members and applicants , and it prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type on the basis of race, color, ethnicity, caste, religion, age, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by our policies or federal, state, or local laws. We want to ensure that our hiring process is accessible. If you need reasonable accommodation for any part of the application process because of a medical condition or disability, please send an email to Please note that: You’ll be required to attend meetings on camera via video conferencing Expect to travel at least two times a year: once for our all-hands meetup and again for a team retreat (each around 4-5 days). While extenuating circumstances may impact attendance, everyone is strongly encouraged to attend. Willkommen bei Sanoptis – einem führenden Netzwerk moderner Augenkliniken und augenärztlicher Praxen mit über 530 Standorten in ganz Europa. Unsere Vision ist es, Wohlbefinden und Lebensqualität durch erstklassige augenärztliche Behandlung zu verbessern. Unser innovatives, dezentrales Modell ermöglicht es unseren Partnerstandorten, unabhängig zu operieren und sich auf die individuellen Bedürfnisse ihrer Patienten zu konzentrieren. Gleichzeitig sind sie Teil eines größeren Netzwerks mit starken Partnern, das ihnen Synergieeffekte, modernste Technik und viele weitere Vorteile bietet.

Dich begeistert ein Mix aus strategischem Gestaltungsspielraum und operativ-kommerzieller Optimierung und Du willst Deine wirtschaftliche Expertise bei einem dynamisch wachsenden Player der Augenheilkunde unter Beweis stellen? Dann sollten wir uns kennenlernen.

In dieser Rolle wirst Du zur Führung und Optimierung der kaufmännischen Aktivitäten mehrerer Augenzentren in Bern die kaufmännische Geschäftsführung übernehmen. Dein Verantwortungsbereich umfasst die strategische Überwachung, das Leistungsmanagement, die Teamführung und die Zusammenarbeit mit funktionsübergreifenden Teams. Dein Engagement für hervorragende Leistungen wird dazu beitragen, die Geschäftsziele zu erreichen, die Patientenzufriedenheit zu erhöhen und das Wachstum der Präsenz von Sanoptis in der Region zu fördern.


In dieser Rolle wirst Du

  • Unsere Augenzentren kaufmännisch leiten: Du wirst den Betrieb mehrerer Zentren wirtschaftlich leiten und dabei die Einhaltung der Sanoptis-Standards in den Einrichtungen sicherstellen.
  • Betriebsergebnisse und Geschäftsziele verantworten: Die betrieblichen Leistungskennzahlen zu Patientenzufriedenheit, Finanzindikatoren, Einnahmen, Ausgaben und Rentabilität wirst Du überwachen. Ferner wirst Du mit den Finanz- und Buchhaltungsteams bei der Entwicklung und Verwaltung von Budgets, Finanzprognosen und Kostenkontrollmaßnahmen zusammenarbeiten.
  • Leistungsziele definieren: Du wirst Leistungsbewertungen durchführen und Ziele definieren. Es ist Dir ein wesentliches Anliegen, für Deine Mitarbeiter und Teams ein positives Arbeitsumfeld zu gewährleisten, das Leistung durch effektive Kommunikation und Zusammenarbeit fördert.
  • Die regionale Strategie planen: Die Formulierung regionaler, strategischer Pläne im Einklang mit unseren übergeordneten Geschäftszielen erarbeitest Du. Hierfür wirst Du eng mit dem Head of Operations sowie Ärzten und Fachkräften vor Ort arbeiten und netzwerken.
  • Wachstum durch Standortentwicklung vorantreiben: Du siehst Wachstumschancen in Deiner Region und erkennst sie frühzeitig, um sie gewinnbringend zu nutzen. Du wirst durch effektive Marketing- und Werbestrategien zur Steigerung des Patientenaufkommens in enger Zusammenarbeit mit dem Marketingteam beitragen. Dein Ziel ist es, einen Ausbau des Marktanteils zu erreichen.


Du wirst zusammenarbeiten mit

  • Einem starken Operationsteam, bestehend aus vielen Ex-Beratern (Bain, BCG, Roland Berger, Oliver Wyman).
  • Leitenden Angestellten und Führungskräften bei Sanoptis, darunter der Head of Operations und das Führungsteam, das für klinische Innovation und hervorragende Dienstleistungen verantwortlich ist.
  • Renommierten Spezialisten und führenden Experten auf dem Gebiet der Augenheilkunde.
  • Einem engagierten und qualifizierten Team von medizinischen Fachkräften und Assistenzärzten.
  • Interdisziplinären Teams in unserem gesamten Netzwerk, einschließlich Technologieexperten, die an den neuesten Fortschritten in der augenmedizinischen Behandlung und digitalen Gesundheitslösungen arbeiten.


Dein Profil überzeugt durch

  • Einschlägige Berufserfahrung in einem anspruchsvollen Umfeld, z. B. in der Strategieberatung (McKinsey, Bain, BCG o.Ä.) oder in ähnlich schnelllebigen Unternehmen.
  • Die nachgewiesene Fähigkeit, Geschäfts- und Finanzanalysen auf Führungsebene zu erstellen und zu kommunizieren. Du erstellst Analysen akribisch und detailorientiert.
  • Unternehmerisches Denken mit der Fähigkeit, große Verantwortung zu übernehmen und Problemlösungen unabhängig voranzutreiben. Eine eigenständige Arbeitsweise mit wenig Anleitung ist essenziell.
  • Nachgewiesene Erfolge im Umgang mit Interessensgruppen, einschließlich der Fähigkeit, ohne formale Autorität Einfluss zu nehmen und Dir eine wichtige Rolle bei der Entscheidungsfindung zu sichern. Du besitzt die Fähigkeit, auch in schwierigen Situationen Konflikte konstruktiv zu lösen und Durchsetzungsstärke zu behalten.
  • Ausgeprägte Fähigkeiten im Bereich Organisation und Prozessmanagement.
  • Exzellente Deutschkenntnisse (C2-Niveau), Französischkenntnisse von Vorteil sowie Englischkenntnisse.
  • Die Bereitschaft, Ergebnisse zu erzielen und Dich in einem schnelllebigen Umfeld mit hoher Verantwortung zu entfalten.


Sanoptis bietet Dir

  • Wettbewerbsfähige Vergütung: Ein äußerst attraktives Gehaltspaket, ergänzt durch einen jährlichen, leistungsabhängigen Bonus, der an individuelle und unternehmensspezifische Leistungsziele gebunden ist.
  • Eigenständigkeit und kreative Freiheit: Die Möglichkeit, Dich zu beweisen, indem Du selbstständig arbeitest und eigene, innovative Ideen umfassend einbringst als Führungspersönlichkeit.
  • Berufliche Entwicklung: Möglichkeiten für kontinuierliches Wachstum und Karrierechancen bei guter Leistung, unterstützt durch Schulungen, Online-Akademien, Workshops und Branchenkonferenzen.
  • Inklusive Kultur: Arbeiten in einem ambitionierten Team mit regelmäßigem Austausch und Teamveranstaltungen.
  • Mitarbeiterrabatte: Vergünstigte Konditionen auf zahlreiche ausgewählte Markenprodukte und Dienstleistungen über unseren Partner Corporate Benefits.
  • Körperliches Wohlbefinden: Eine subventionierte Mitgliedschaft bei Wellpass, die Deine körperliche Gesundheit unterstützt.


Gleiche Chancen

Bei Sanoptis schätzen wir Talent, Leidenschaft und Einstellung über spezifische Erfahrungen. Wir begrüßen Bewerber aus verschiedenen Hintergründen und priorisieren gleiche Chancen für alle.


Kontakt

Wenn Du bereit bist, die digitale Zukunft der Augenheilkunde mitzugestalten, möchten wir von Dir hören! Bewirb Dich jetzt, um unserem dynamischen Team beizutreten und einen bedeutenden Einfluss auf das Leben der Menschen zu haben. Gerne erreichst Du uns unter Find Jobs in Switzerland on Arbeitnow

We balance our long-term vision with short-term pragmatism.   • Fluency with modern orchestration and automation tooling (Kubernetes, Terraform, Ansible - plus the judgment to know when to build vs. buy)

  • A track record of delivering reliable systems and measurable efficiency gains

You can expect:

  • Competitive salary and stock options

  • Flexible working hours

  • Market-leading parental leave

Bei Salonkee lernst du den Vertrieb von Grund auf kennen und baust dir in Basel dein eigenes Netzwerk auf. Salonkee ist Marktführer für Salon-Software in Luxemburg, Belgien und der Schweiz. Über 10.000 Beauty- und Wellness-Betriebe in sieben Ländern nutzen unsere All-in-one-Software – von der Terminbuchung über die Kundenverwaltung und die Kasse bis hin zu Marketing- und KI-Funktionen. Deine Rolle Du verantwortest das Wachstum in deiner Region und bist die zentrale Ansprechperson vor Ort Du gehst aktiv auf Saloninhaber:innen in deiner Region zu – telefonisch, per Walk-in oder über Social Media (Kaltakquise). Vor Ort ermittelst du den Bedarf des Salons mithilfe von Fragen und zeigst anhand von Produktdemos, wie Salonkee den Alltag vereinfachen kann. Du verantwortest deinen eigenen Funnel vom Erstkontakt bis zum Abschluss. Deine Woche planst du eigenverantwortlich, mit klaren Zielen und einer Führungskraft, die dich unterstützt und weiterentwickelt. Das bringst du mit Vertriebserfahrung ist nicht unbedingt notwendig. Wenn du aus dem Hospitality, Beauty, Retail, Fitness, Event oder einem anderen Bereich mit viel Kundenkontakt kommst, bringst du das Wichtigste schon mit. Du bist kontaktfreudig und gehst gerne in den Austausch – egal ob am Telefon oder direkt vor Ort. Du bist in der Lage, Menschen zu begeistern und Interessen zu wecken. Du kannst mit Ablehnung umgehen und richtest den Blick nach vorn. Du bist lernbereit, setzt Feedback um und willst dich weiterentwickeln. Du bist strukturiert, organisiert und sicher im Umgang mit digitalen Tools. Verhandlungssicheres bis muttersprachliches Deutsch sowie gute Englischkenntnisse. Führerschein der Klasse B und Freude daran, in deiner Region unterwegs zu sein. Das erwartet dich bei uns Vertrieb von Grund auf lernen: Bootcamp zum Start, gezieltes Ramp-Up Programm , Shadowing bei erfahrenen Kolleg:innen, Roleplays und regelmäßiges Coaching . Ein Team vor Ort: Team Lead und Kolleg:innen in deiner Region – du startest nicht allein. Ein klarer Entwicklungspfad : von Junior über Senior bis hin zu Führungsrollen. Klare KPIs & Performance-Transparenz, damit du jederzeit weißt, wo du stehst. Eigenverantwortliche Wochenplanung und Vertrauensarbeitszeit. Firmenwagen inkl. Tankkarte sowie MacBook und iPhone. 50 € steuerfreies Guthaben pro Monat über Probonio. Fixgehalt und ungedeckelte Provision . Teamevents, die ihren Namen verdienen: Sommerfest, Winterfeier und regelmäßige Teamformate. Wie geht es weiter? Bewerbung & Sichtung – wir melden uns so schnell wie möglich bei dir. Erstgespräch mit unserem Recruiting-Team (ca. 30–45 Minuten). Video-Call mit deiner künftigen Führungskraft. Field Day – zwei Stunden bei uns im Office. Du siehst, wie wir arbeiten, wir sehen dich in Aktion. Salonkee steht für Chancengleichheit und Vielfalt. Wir freuen uns über Bewerbungen von Menschen mit unterschiedlichen Hintergründen, Perspektiven und Fähigkeiten – unabhängig von Geschlecht, Herkunft, Alter, Behinderung, Religion oder Identität. The next is a world model across every site that predicts the next state in latent space, starting from open world-model weights and growing on field data nobody else holds. Anomaly as surprise: replace rule-based alerting with measured surprise, and work out how to evaluate it when real incidents are rare. World model: post-train open world-model weights on aligned multi-sensor field sequences, JEPA-style, predicting in latent space rather than pixels. Transfer: from one site's memory to a model of all of them, and representations that carry across sites and domains. Flink Robotics delivers superhuman physical work. We are a Zürich-based deep tech startup developing a physics-based world model that lets machines reason about the physical world and do work robots couldn't do before - starting with logistics.

We're a team of engineers and researchers with roots at ETH Zürich, backed by leading European investors. The technology is ambitious; now we want the way we look and show up to match it.

The role

You make Flink look as cool from the outside as it is on the inside. As our first brand & marketing hire, you own how Flink shows up to the world and help shape how it feels to work here.

This is a hands-on role with a lot of ownership from day one. You'll work directly with the CEO and the whole team, and you'll have real freedom to set the tone. We care more about taste, energy and drive than years of experience; junior profiles are very welcome.

What you'll do

  • Own our look and feel. Evolve and guard Flink's visual identity. Logo use, colours, typography, photo and video style: and make sure everything we put out is consistent.

  • Run our website. Keep flink.so fresh, fast and on-message: new pages, news, job posts, visuals. Work with freelancers or agencies where needed.

  • Build our social presence. Plan and create content for LinkedIn and other channels. Robot footage, behind-the-scenes, team stories, milestones and grow an audience that gets excited about what we do.

  • Run marketing campaigns. Turn our story into campaigns, from product launches and trade fair pushes to customer and recruiting campaigns. You own the creative and the message, and work closely with the Growth team on goals, audiences and channels.

  • Tell our story visually. Create or coordinate photos, videos, graphics and animations of our robots and technology. Support pitch decks, investor updates and sales materials so they look world-class.

  • Organise events. From trade fairs and demo days to meetups, customer visits and team events. Plan them, run them and make them memorable.

  • Make our space amazing. Shape how our office and workshop look and feel, so every visitor - investor, customer or candidate - gets the Flink vibe.

  • Strengthen our employer brand. Help us attract top engineers: careers page, job ads, recruiting content, how candidates experience Flink.

  • Bring the brand inside. Help build team culture through internal communication, onboarding touches, swag; you name it.

What you bring

  • A strong eye for design and visuals: you know what looks great.

  • Creativity and ideas of your own: you don't wait for a brief to start making things

  • Hands-on skills in design tools (e.g. Figma, Adobe Creative Suite, Canva) and comfort creating content for social media

  • A portfolio that shows your taste: professional, freelance, student or side projects all count

  • Organisational talent: you can juggle an event, a website update and a video shoot in the same week

  • Excellent written and spoken English

  • Curiosity about technology and robotics: you don't need to be an engineer, but you want to understand what we build

  • First experience in branding, marketing, design or communications (internships count)

Nice to have

  • German (spoken or written)

  • Photo or video shooting and editing skills

  • Experience with website design

  • Interior design, set design or event production experience

  • Previous startup or tech-company experience

What we offer

  • The chance to build a brand from the ground up at a deep tech startup on the rise

  • Real ownership and direct access to the founders: your work is visible from day one

  • Robots, a workshop and a story worth telling: some of the most exciting content in tech, waiting to be shown to the world

  • A growing, ambitious team in Zürich

  • Competitive salary and employee stock options

  • Budget and freedom to try new ideas

title: Chief of Staff
description: Overview Physical AI, a real model of the world, is the next trillion dollar opportunity and a foundational pillar for energy, robotics and superintelligence. At Jua we are building it now. Our models already run on four continents and help power the energy buildout needed to support ever larger intelligence. We are assembling a world-class team of researchers and entrepreneurial minds to turn this model into reality at global scale. If you want the opportunity of your life, come build physical AI with us. The Role You work directly with Jua’s Leadership. You operate as a force multiplier — plugging into whatever's highest-leverage that day, from fundraising and investor work to product calls, deals, and fixing what's broken before it slows us down. What you're pulled into will shift as the business does — some stretches this is heavily fundraising and investor-facing, others it's operational firefighting or unsticking a cross-functional project. Ogilvy was named <a href="https://www.ogilvy.com/ideas/ogilvy-brings-home-network-year-2026-cannes-lions-international-festival-creativity">Network of the Year</a> at the 2026 Cannes Lions International Festival of Creativity and<span class="Apple-converted-space">&nbsp;</span><a href="https://www.ogilvy.com/ideas/ogilvy-tops-warc-effective-100-creative-100-4th-straight-year" data-outlook-id="e2c78315-ff05-4544-925f-9288319dea2c">ranks</a><span class="Apple-converted-space">&nbsp;</span>as the #1 global agency network for creative excellence and effectiveness by WARC for the fourth consecutive year, signifying its ability to deliver creative solutions that drive unreasonable impact for clients and communities. Ogilvy is part of WPP, the trusted growth partner for the world's leading brands. Powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform WPP Open, WPP unites cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, creativity, production, enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel.<span class="Apple-converted-space">&nbsp;</span>For more information, visit <a href="http://www.ogilvy.com/" target="_blank" data-outlook-id="39833259-880d-4fd8-930f-0d84b1c14850">Ogilvy.com</a>, and follow us on<span class="Apple-converted-space">&nbsp;</span><a href="https://www.linkedin.com/company/ogilvy/" data-outlook-id="735e393e-6e8a-4ca8-804a-74f1bd8166b6">LinkedIn</a>, <a href="https://twitter.com/ogilvy" data-outlook-id="d10960ce-761b-48c5-81d5-0a7c4cc6013a">X</a>,<a href="https://www.instagram.com/ogilvy/" data-outlook-id="92ffcb70-6ca7-4d9a-88d5-c130e36e6c4f"> Instagram</a>, and<a href="https://www.facebook.com/ogilvy/" data-outlook-id="3bd2010d-00a2-401b-8cfb-7e8c24deac52"> Facebook.</a></p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>About WPP</strong></p> <p>WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. We unite&nbsp;cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel&nbsp;in a single company –&nbsp;powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open,&nbsp;to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit&nbsp;<u><a href="http://wpp.com/" data-outlook-id="7f087527-f491-4cb6-a79d-3b4a67d1ec89">WPP.com</a></u>.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p></div><p>Ogilvy Health DACH ist eine grenzenlos agierende Kreativagentur, die durch nahtlose Zusammenarbeit über Disziplinen und Märkte hinweg Projekte realisiert – von lokalen Initiativen bis hin zu globalen Kampagnen. Unser Team arbeitet an der Schnittstelle von <strong>Healthcare, Social Media, Strategie, Experience und Influence</strong>.</p> <p>Von Zürich aus betreuen wir das Healthcare-Portfolio von Ogilvy für die DACH-Region sowie ausgewählte internationale Kund:innen aus den Bereichen Pharma, Biotech und Medizintechnik. Unser interdisziplinäres Health-Team vereint Account Management, Medical Writing, PR, Digital, Strategie und Kreation.</p> <p>Zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt suchen wir eine:n<strong> Designer/ Art Director Health (m/w/d)&nbsp;</strong>in Berlin, Hamburg, Frankfurt/ Main, Düsseldorf oder Zürich.&nbsp;</p> <p>&nbsp;Das bieten wir:</p> <ul> <li>Möglichkeit zur Arbeit im Mobile Office (bis zu 100%)&nbsp;</li> <li>Nutzung unseres&nbsp;WPP Weiterbildungsnetzwerkes, inkl. LinkedIn Learning&nbsp;</li> <li>Unterstützung bei der privaten Altersvorsorge und die Gewährung von vermögenswirksamen Leistungen&nbsp;</li> <li>Jubiläumsprämien in Form von zusätzlichen Urlaubstagen&nbsp;</li> <li>Möglichkeit zur Nutzung eines Job Bikes&nbsp;</li> <li>Erweiterte Betriebliche Krankenversicherung mit einem zusätzlichen Budget von bis zu 300€ im Jahr&nbsp;</li> <li>Zugriff auf unser&nbsp;Employee&nbsp;Assistance Programm&nbsp;TELUS Health&nbsp;</li> <li>Kostenlose Nutzung der&nbsp;Headspace-App&nbsp;</li> <li>Subventionierte&nbsp;Gympass-Mitgliedschaft&nbsp;</li> </ul> <p>Deine Aufgaben:&nbsp;</p> <p>Als Art Director Health entwickelst und gestaltest du Kommunikationslösungen für renommierte Kund:innen aus dem Healthcare- und Pharmabereich. Dein Aufgabenspektrum reicht – je nach Projekt – von konkreten Kommunikationsmitteln wie Flyern, Broschüren, Präsentationen und Sales-Materialien bis hin zu visuellen Identitäten, digitalen Inhalten und integrierten Kampagnen.<br>Du entwickelst starke visuelle Konzepte, übersetzt medizinische und wissenschaftliche Inhalte in klare, relevante Kommunikation und begleitest Projekte von der ersten Idee bis zur finalen Umsetzung. Dabei arbeitest du eng mit Medical Writing, Client Services, Strategie, Creative Direction, Digital, PR, Production und externen Partner:innen zusammen.<br>Die Rolle erfordert kreative Exzellenz und ein gutes Verständnis für die besonderen Anforderungen der Healthcare-Kommunikation – insbesondere für Rx-Produkte, regulatorische Vorgaben und Review-Prozesse.</p> <ul> <li>Konzeption und Gestaltung von Kommunikationsmitteln für Print, Digital, Social Media und Bewegtbild – von Flyern, Broschüren und Präsentationen bis zu digitalen Assets und Kampagnenformaten</li> <li>Entwicklung visueller Identitäten, Corporate Designs, Branding-Lösungen, Kampagnenwelten und visueller Narrative für Pharma-, Biotech- und Medtech-Kund:innen</li> <li>Übersetzung medizinischer und wissenschaftlicher Inhalte in klare, zielgruppengerechte und visuell überzeugende Lösungen, insbesondere für Rx-, Disease-Awareness- und Patient-Engagement-Projekte</li> <li>Präsentation und überzeugende Vermittlung von Ideen gegenüber Kund:innen sowie Begleitung der Umsetzung und Sicherstellung der gestalterischen Qualität über alle Kanäle und Formate hinweg</li> <li>Zusammenarbeit mit internen Fachbereichen und externen Partner:innen wie Fotograf:innen, Filmproduktionen, Freelancer:innen und Partneragenturen sowie Unterstützung bei Pitches, Neugeschäftsprojekten und der Weiterentwicklung bestehender Kund:innenbeziehungen</li> </ul> <p>Was du mitbringst:&nbsp;</p> <ul> <li>Abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Grafiker:in EFZ, Studium in Visueller Kommunikation, Grafikdesign oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation sowie mehrjährige Berufserfahrung als Art Director in einer Healthcare-, Pharma- oder Kommunikationsagentur</li> <li>Fundierte Erfahrung in der Zusammenarbeit mit Kund:innen aus Pharma, Biotech und/oder Medtech sowie nachweisbare Erfahrung mit Kommunikationsmassnahmen für Rx-Produkte</li> <li>Gutes Verständnis für medizinische Inhalte, regulatorische Anforderungen und Review-Prozesse in der Healthcare-Kommunikation</li> <li>Ausgeprägte konzeptionelle und gestalterische Fähigkeiten, ein überzeugendes Portfolio sowie sicherer Umgang mit der Adobe Creative Cloud und gängigen Design- und Präsentationstools</li> <li>Ausgeprägte Kommunikations- und Präsentationsfähigkeiten, ein sicheres Auftreten gegenüber Kund:innen sowie sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift</li> <li>Erfahrung mit Patient Engagement, PR- und Awareness-Kampagnen sowie Kenntnisse in Motion Design und Social/Digital Content Creation sind ein Plus.</li> <li>Du verbindest kreative Exzellenz mit strategischem Denken und kannst komplexe Inhalte schnell erfassen und in relevante visuelle Ideen übersetzen.</li> <li>Du arbeitest proaktiv, selbständig, lösungsorientiert und zuverlässig – sowohl an grösseren Projekten als auch an konkreten Kommunikationsmitteln im Tagesgeschäft.</li> <li>Du kommunizierst klar, präsentierst sicher und kannst Kund:innen für deine Ideen begeistern. Die Zusammenarbeit in interdisziplinären und internationalen Teams macht dir Freude.</li> <li>Du bringst Resilienz und Flexibilität für einen dynamischen und phasenweise intensiven Agenturalltag mit. Nicht alles ist planbar, Prioritäten und Timings können sich kurzfristig ändern.</li> <li>Auch bei hohem Tempo und mehreren parallelen Projekten bewahrst du den Überblick, hast einen hohen Qualitätsanspruch und übernimmst Verantwortung. In intensiven Phasen bist du bereit, gemeinsam mit dem Team die Extrameile zu gehen.</li> </ul> <p>Wir glauben an die Kraft von Diversität und Kollaboration. Den Herausforderungen der heutigen Welt können wir nur gemeinsam begegnen.&nbsp;Wir verpflichten uns daher, für den Job in Frage kommende Bewerber:innen ausschließlich nach ihren Fähigkeiten und grundsätzlich unabhängig von Alter, Geschlecht, ethnischer Zugehörigkeit, sexueller Orientierung, Behinderung oder Religion zu beurteilen.</p> <p>Das klingt nach einer spannenden Herausforderung? Sehr gut, dein Ansprechpartner Kai Schlüter freut sich über deine Bewerbung!<br>Aus Gründen der Nachhaltigkeit und des Datenschutzes bitten wir darum, Bewerbungsunterlagen ausschließlich über unsere Bewerber:innenplattform Greenhouse an uns zu senden. Wir würden uns freuen, wenn auf das Mitsenden eines Fotos verzichtet würde.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p>At Ogilvy, our people are at the heart of what we do: a creative agency that sparks game-changing ideas across culture and business through collaboration, integrity, and a celebration of self-expression.&nbsp;</p> <p>We believe in building powerful teams with purpose - and we relentlessly curate transformative initiatives that make our commitment to fairness, and equity a reality.&nbsp;</p> <p>Our ultimate mission is to leave a positive impact on the world, creating a better future for all, while supporting and uplifting the global communities we serve.&nbsp; This is central to our mantra of Borderless Creativity.</p> <p><span data-teams="true">Ogilvy is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to particular characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers.</span></p> <p>If you need any assistance seeking a job opportunity, or if you need reasonable accommodation with the application process, please contact us at ----- Please note that this contact is only for candidates who are requesting accommodation. Emails for other purposes, including application status requests, will not receive a response.</p></div> Find Jobs in Switzerland on Arbeitnow

description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>About IonQ:&nbsp;</strong><strong><br></strong></p> <p><u><a href="https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&amp;url=https%3A%2F%2Fionq.com%2F&amp;esheet=54451094&amp;newsitemid=20260316477473&amp;lan=en-US&amp;anchor=IonQ%2C+Inc&amp;index=7&amp;md5=0818ffbedc6dbad8c4d1611ac94c2a0f" target="_blank">IonQ, Inc</a></u>. [NYSE: IONQ] is the world’s leading quantum platform and merchant supplier - delivering integrated quantum solutions across computing, networking, sensing, and security. IonQ’s newest generation of quantum computers, the IonQ Tempo, is the latest in a line of cutting-edge systems that have been helping customers and partners including <u><a href="https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&amp;url=https%3A%2F%2Fionq.com%2Fnews%2Fionq-speeds-quantum-accelerated-drug-development-application-with&amp;esheet=54451094&amp;newsitemid=20260316477473&amp;lan=en-US&amp;anchor=Amazon+Web+Services%2C&amp;index=8&amp;md5=a7f94ee9b71a392dca3cd6c413722e51" target="_blank">Amazon Web Services, </a></u><u><a href="https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&amp;url=https%3A%2F%2Fionq.com%2Fnews%2Fionq-speeds-quantum-accelerated-drug-development-application-with&amp;esheet=54451094&amp;newsitemid=20260316477473&amp;lan=en-US&amp;anchor=and&amp;index=9&amp;md5=2bed627b388878763f41ffe0e4edb16c" target="_blank">and </a></u><u><a href="https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&amp;url=https%3A%2F%2Fionq.com%2Fnews%2Fionq-speeds-quantum-accelerated-drug-development-application-with&amp;esheet=54451094&amp;newsitemid=20260316477473&amp;lan=en-US&amp;anchor=AstraZeneca&amp;index=10&amp;md5=757c1f2c2ec94cf3982700106122164f" target="_blank">AstraZeneca</a></u> achieve 20x performance results and accelerate innovation in drug discovery, materials science, financial modeling, logistics, cybersecurity, and defense. In 2025, the company achieved 99.99% two-qubit gate fidelity, <u><a href="https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&amp;url=https%3A%2F%2Fionq.com%2Fnews%2Fionq-achieves-landmark-result-setting-new-world-record-in-quantum-computing&amp;esheet=54451094&amp;newsitemid=20260316477473&amp;lan=en-US&amp;anchor=setting+a+world+record+in+quantum+computing+performance&amp;index=11&amp;md5=32e9cb88afbd439026a352666cc72c91" target="_blank">setting a world record in quantum computing performance</a></u>.<br><br>Headquartered in College Park, Maryland, IonQ has operations in California, Colorado, Massachusetts, Tennessee, Washington, Italy, South Korea, Sweden, Switzerland, Canada, and the United Kingdom. Our quantum computing services are available through all major cloud providers, while we also meet the needs of networking and sensing customers across land, sea, air, and space. IonQ is making quantum platforms more accessible and impactful than ever before. &nbsp;</p></div><p><span class="s1"><span class="TextRun SCXW3980620 BCX0" data-contrast="auto"><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW3980620 BCX0"><strong>What to expect</strong></span></span></span></p> <p>We are looking for a Staff System Architect to be fully dedicated to the SNSPD product line, with a strong focus on leading the technical architecture and roadmap for our next-generation rack-mountable SNSPD (Superconducting Nanowire Single-Photon Detector) platform. This role is critical to defining and guiding the technical evolution of our cutting-edge cryogenic photon detection systems, ensuring architectural coherence across hardware, software, and integration domains while supporting our product vision and market requirements.</p> <p>We are looking for a proven architect of complex, multi-domain instruments, whether from space systems, astronomical instrumentation, scientific or medical imaging, electron or advanced optical microscopy, semiconductor equipment, or comparable fields who can bring that system-level rigour to our platform.</p> <p><span class="s1"><span class="TextRun SCXW3980620 BCX0" data-contrast="auto"><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW3980620 BCX0"><strong><span class="TextRun SCXW243108471 BCX0" data-contrast="auto"><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW243108471 BCX0">What you'll be doing</span></span></strong></span></span></span></p> <p>In this role, you will be an integral part of the development process for IDQ's SNSPD platform, with applications across quantum computing, networking, and sensing. You will be at the intersection of quantum photonics, cryogenic systems engineering and embedded systems to create scalable, maintainable architectures for autonomous 24/7 detector operations.</p> <p>You will take ownership of the end-to-end system architecture of the SNSPD platform, ensuring alignment with a shared long-term product vision while translating product requirements into clear system-level designs and specifications. This includes defining system structure, interfaces, and key architectural decisions, as well as driving critical trade-offs across performance, cost, scalability, and integration. You will also align engineering execution with the architectural vision, guiding system integration and resolving complex cross-domain design challenges.</p> <p>In addition, you will play a key role in shaping the technology roadmap and driving the evolution of the platform, continuously evaluating and introducing new technologies where relevant to maintain innovation and competitiveness.</p> <ul> <li>Lead system architecture, design decisions, and cross-functional alignment to ensure a scalable and high-performing SNSPD platform</li> <li>Drive technology roadmap, integration, and innovation by evaluating and implementing new technologies</li> </ul> <p><strong><span class="s1">What you'll bring</span></strong></p> <p>We are seeking an experienced professional with a Master's degree (PhD preferred) in physics, electrical engineering, photonics, or a related field, and 7+ years of experience in the design of complex, multi-domain systems, with demonstrated ownership of system architecture. The ideal candidate has architected instruments or platforms of comparable complexity, combining optics or photonics with electronics, mechanics or thermal design, and embedded or software components and has proven experience integrating these technologies into cohesive, high-performing products.</p> <p>You will demonstrate strong technical leadership across multidisciplinary teams, with the ability to clearly communicate complex system architectures to a wide range of stakeholders. This includes ensuring alignment, supporting informed decision-making, and driving successful collaboration across functions to deliver robust and scalable system designs.</p> <ul> <li>Extensive experience in system architecture and multi-domain integration, with strong system-level thinking</li> <li>Proven technical leadership and communication skills, enabling alignment and effective decision-making across diverse teams</li> </ul> <p><strong><span class="s1">You'll be a great fit with</span></strong></p> <ul> <li>Background in domains of comparable complexity: space instrumentation, astronomy, high-end microscopy or imaging, semiconductor or scientific equipment</li> <li>Experience with photonics, low-noise electronics, cryogenics, or vacuum systems</li> <li>Experience with SNSPDs, single-photon detection, or quantum systems</li> <li>Experience bringing industrialized or rack-mountable systems to market</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p>Compensation will vary based on individual factors such as education, qualifications, and experience of the final candidate(s), specific office location, and calibration against relevant market data and internal team equity. Posted base salary figures are subject to change as new market data becomes available. Our benefits include comprehensive medical, dental, and vision plans, matching 401(k), unlimited PTO and paid holidays, parental/adoption leave, legal insurance, and a home technology stipend. Details of participation in these benefit plans will be provided when a candidate receives an offer of employment.&nbsp;</p> <p>At IonQ, we believe in fair treatment, access, opportunity, and advancement for all while striving to identify and eliminate barriers. We empower employees to thrive by fostering a culture of autonomy, productivity, and respect. We are dedicated to creating an environment where individuals can feel welcomed, respected, supported, and valued.<br>&nbsp;<br>We are committed to equity and justice. We welcome different voices and viewpoints and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, ancestry, physical and/or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, transgender status, age, sexual orientation, military or veteran status, or any other basis protected by law. We are proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>US Technical Jobs.&nbsp;</strong>The position you are applying for will require access to technology that is subject to U.S. export control and government contract restrictions.&nbsp; Employment with IonQ is contingent on either verifying “U.S. Person” (e.g., U.S. citizen, U.S. national, U.S. permanent resident, or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum) status for export controls and government contracts work, obtaining any necessary license, and/or confirming the availability of a license exception under U.S. export controls.&nbsp; Please note that in the absence of confirming you are a U.S. Person for export control and government contracts work purposes, IonQ may choose not to apply for a license or decline to use a license exception (if available) for you to access export-controlled technology that may require authorization, and similarly, you may not qualify for government contracts work that requires U.S. Persons, and IonQ may decline to proceed with your application on those bases alone.&nbsp; Accordingly, we will have some additional questions regarding your immigration status that will be used for export control and compliance purposes, and the answers will be reviewed by compliance personnel to ensure compliance with federal law.&nbsp;&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>US Non-Technical Jobs.&nbsp;</strong>Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum. Accordingly, we will have some additional questions regarding your immigration status that will be used for export control and compliance purposes, and the answers will be reviewed by compliance personnel to ensure compliance with federal law.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>If you are interested in being a part of our team and mission, we encourage you to apply!&nbsp;</p></div> Find Jobs in Switzerland on Arbeitnow

Deepgram’s voice-native foundation models are accessed through cloud APIs or as self-hosted and on-premises software, with unmatched accuracy, low latency, and cost efficiency. Backed by a recent Series C led by leading global investors and strategic partners, Deepgram has processed over 50,000 years of audio and transcribed more than 1 trillion words. There is no organization in the world that understands voice better than Deepgram.

At Deepgram, we expect an AI-first mindset—AI use and comfort aren’t optional, they’re core to how we operate, innovate, and measure performance.

Every team member who works at Deepgram is expected to actively use and experiment with advanced AI tools, and even build your own into your everyday work.
